items.title: 民主黨期中選舉橫掃或打崩美股！美銀：恐跌逾10%、戳破AI泡沫
items.title_en: Democrats' Midterm Sweep Could Crash US Stocks! BofA: Over 10% Drop, AI Bubble Burst
paras: 美銀證券（BofA Securities）首席投資策略師Michael Hartnett警告，全球債券殖利率升至20年高點，正逐漸成為人工智慧（AI）資本支出熱潮面臨的最大威脅，而即將登場的美國期中選舉，可能成為引爆市場波動的關鍵變數，若民主黨橫掃參眾兩院，美股恐跌逾10%，AI泡沫也可能面臨破裂風險。
Hartnett在最新一期《Flow Show》週報中指出，若民主黨在期中選舉「橫掃」參眾兩院，美股可能下跌超過10%，美元走弱、債券殖利率下滑，AI泡沫也將面臨破裂風險。
他認為，「民主黨橫掃」是目前市場最大的尾部風險之一，但投資人幾乎尚未將此情境反映在資產價格中。
Polymarket數據顯示，民主黨橫掃兩院的機率已升至50%，遠高於共和黨橫掃的10%。另一方面，美國總統川普目前支持率約落在35%至40%，明顯低於歷年期中選舉前兩個月53%的平均水準。

全球債市同步示警　長天期殖利率成AI交易關鍵

Hartnett認為，上週市場最值得關注的並非優於預期的就業數據，而是全球債券市場同步遭遇拋售。
美國10年期公債殖利率升至4.81%，接近2008年金融危機時期水準；30年期殖利率則升至5.31%，創2007年以來新高。
此外，日本10年期國債殖利率1996年以來首次突破3%，30年期日債殖利率也升至4.2%，約為日本央行政策利率的4倍。
歐洲債市同樣承壓，德國10年期公債殖利率升至3.38%，創2011年後新高；法德利差擴大至88個基點、義德利差達84個基點，均觸及2012年歐債危機時期水準。
彭博全球債券殖利率指數也升至2007年以來最高，距離本世紀高點僅剩1個百分點。
Hartnett將這項趨勢概括為「債券主導泡沫」，認為目前AI交易真正的關鍵並非股市敘事，而是長天期債券殖利率。
他指出，在全球30年期殖利率降至5%以下前，AI基礎建設的建設商與投資方表現都可能持續落後於AI應用業者。

期中選舉成市場低估變數　民主黨橫掃衝擊資產價格

Hartnett表示，美國期中選舉並不像1980年撒切爾與雷根時代，或2016年英國脫歐、川普當選等事件，屬於足以改變政權方向的重大選舉，因此不會從根本扭轉美國政府支出持續上升的趨勢。
但他認為，選舉結果不同，仍可能對資產價格產生結構性影響。
美銀8月基金經理人調查顯示，47%受訪者預期最終結果將是「共和黨掌握參議院、民主黨控制眾議院」，23%預期民主黨橫掃，僅9%認為共和黨能維持兩院控制權。
目前共和黨在參議院以53席對47席領先，眾議院則以218席對212席領先。
Hartnett指出，若民主黨要實現參議院橫掃，必須在北卡羅來納、緬因、阿拉斯加、俄亥俄、德州與愛荷華等6個共和黨相對脆弱的席位中至少拿下4席，同時守住喬治亞、新罕布夏與密西根等自身較脆弱席位。
其中，俄亥俄、德州、愛荷華與密西根將是投資人需要密切關注的關鍵戰場。
值得注意的是，華爾街近期也開始關注德州州長選舉。共和黨現任州長Greg Abbott目前民調支持率為49%，略高於民主黨挑戰者Gina Hinojosa的45%，雙方選戰結果被視為觀察AI資料中心擴張政策走向的重要指標。
為扭轉支持率下滑，Abbott近期也宣布暫停資料中心建設。

民主黨若橫掃　AI資本支出與華爾街可能承壓

Hartnett認為，若選舉結果從「民粹資本主義」轉向「民粹社會主義」，政策方向可能從減稅、放鬆監管轉向提高稅負與監管，進而對企業獲利造成壓力。
與此同時，壓低通膨、提高醫療可及性及改善K型財富分化等政策方向，也可能對AI資本支出熱潮與華爾街「大而不倒」的金融生態造成衝擊。
此外，川普政治資本若流失，也可能削弱其在AI、資源壟斷及外交施壓等優先議題上的政策執行能力。
在民主黨橫掃情境下，Hartnett建議做空金融股與美元。他認為美股跌幅可能超過10%，美元走弱、債券殖利率下行；國際股市則有望相對抗跌，其中歐股表現可能優於亞洲市場。
反之，若共和黨意外守住參眾兩院，則可能帶動整體風險偏好回升，AI泡沫獲得進一步支撐，美元「例外主義」敘事也可能重新升溫。
至於市場目前最普遍預期的「共和黨掌握參議院、民主黨控制眾議院」，Hartnett則認為將對應較溫和的風險偏好，形成所謂「僵局即金髮女孩」的市場環境。

Hartnett續看多黃金與商品　AI擁擠交易成主要風險

在整體資產配置上，Hartnett仍維持做多商品與黃金的核心策略，作為因應通膨與地緣政治風險的工具。
他指出，各國政府採取「不惜一切代價」的財政干預，正在壓制長天期殖利率並支撐名目GDP成長，因此「任何資產都優於債券」的策略邏輯仍然存在。
不過，在AI交易方面，Hartnett的態度明顯更為謹慎。他指出，超大規模雲端業者的自由現金流在資本支出承諾壓力下已轉為負值，AI泡沫可能「隨時破裂」。
因此，他提出「做多屈辱、做空傲慢」的後泡沫投資框架，建議投資人轉向長天期債券與防禦型產業，包括必需消費品、礦業與原材料、醫療保健等，同時避開目前交易過度擁擠的AI基礎建設相關標的。
從長期資產表現來看，Hartnett也指出，美股過去10年滾動報酬率達15%，大宗商品為11%，美國公債則為-2%，創下近百年最差紀錄。
歷史資料顯示，債券長期報酬轉負後，往往成為股票與商品較佳的買進時機。這也構成Hartnett戰術性看好第四季債券的歷史依據。
paras_en: Bank of America Securities chief investment strategist Michael Hartnett warned that global bond yields have risen to a 20‑year high, becoming the biggest threat to the AI capital‑spending boom, and that the upcoming US midterm election could be the key trigger for market volatility. If Democrats sweep both chambers, US equities could fall more than 10% and the AI bubble could burst.
Hartnett noted in the latest weekly Flow Show that a Democratic sweep of the Senate and House could push US stocks down over 10%, weaken the dollar, lower bond yields, and jeopardize the AI bubble.
He said a Democratic sweep is one of the market’s biggest tail‑risk scenarios, yet investors have barely priced it into assets.

Polymarket data shows the probability of a Democratic sweep of both chambers has risen to 50%, far above the 10% chance for a Republican sweep. Meanwhile, President Trump’s approval sits around 35‑40%, well below the historical average of 53% two months before midterms.
Global bond markets are all flashing warnings, with long‑term yields becoming the key to AI trading.
US 10‑year Treasury yields jumped to 4.81%, near 2008 crisis levels, while the 30‑year hit 5.31%, a high not seen since 2007.
Japan’s 10‑year JGB broke 3% for the first time since 1996, and the 30‑year rose to 4.2%, about four times the Bank of Japan’s policy rate.

European bonds are under pressure too: Germany’s 10‑year yield rose to 3.38%, a post‑2011 high; the Franco‑German spread widened to 88 basis points and the Italy‑Germany spread hit 84 basis points, both touching 2012 euro‑debt crisis levels.
Bloomberg’s global bond yield index climbed to its highest since 2007, now just one percentage point below the century‑high.
Hartnett labeled the trend a “bond‑driven bubble,” arguing that the real driver of AI trading is long‑term bond yields, not equity narratives.
He warned that until 30‑year yields fall below 5%, AI infrastructure builders and investors will likely lag behind AI application firms.
Hartnett said the US midterms aren’t as transformative as the 1980 Thatcher‑Reagan era, Brexit, or Trump’s 2016 win, so they won’t fundamentally reverse the upward trend in government spending.
Nevertheless, the outcome could still have structural effects on asset prices.

BofA’s August fund‑manager survey found 47% expect a split outcome (Republicans keep the Senate, Democrats the House), 23% foresee a Democratic sweep, and only 9% think Republicans will retain both chambers.
Republicans currently lead the Senate 53‑47 and the House 218‑212.

Hartnett explained that for a Democratic Senate sweep they would need to win at least four of six vulnerable Republican seats—North Carolina, Maine, Alaska, Ohio, Texas and Iowa—while defending their own weaker seats in Georgia, New Hampshire and Michigan.
Ohio, Texas, Iowa and Michigan are the key battlegrounds investors should watch closely.

Wall Street is also watching the Texas governor’s race; incumbent Republican Greg Abbott polls at 49% versus Democrat Gina Hinojosa’s 45%, and the result is seen as a barometer for AI data‑center expansion policy.
To halt his slipping approval, Abbott recently announced a pause on new data‑center construction.

Hartnett argued that a shift from “populist capitalism” to “populist socialism” would move policy from tax cuts and deregulation toward higher taxes and tighter regulation, squeezing corporate profits.

At the same time, policies aimed at lowering inflation, expanding healthcare access and reducing wealth inequality could also dampen the AI spending boom and strain Wall Street’s “too‑big‑to‑fail” financial ecosystem.
If Trump’s political capital erodes, his ability to push AI, resource‑monopoly and foreign‑policy agendas could weaken.

In a Democratic‑sweep scenario, Hartnett recommends shorting financial stocks and the dollar, expecting US equities to drop over 10%, a weaker dollar and falling yields, while international markets—especially European equities—could hold up better than Asia.
Conversely, if Republicans unexpectedly retain both chambers, risk appetite may rise, further supporting the AI bubble and reviving the dollar‑“exceptionalism” narrative.
For the currently most‑expected split outcome (Republicans Senate, Democrats House), Hartnett sees a moderate risk‑on environment he dubs a “stalemate‑goldilocks” market.
Hartnett remains bullish on gold and commodities, viewing them as core tools against inflation and geopolitical risk.
He notes that governments’ “all‑out” fiscal interventions are suppressing long‑term yields and propping up nominal GDP growth, keeping the “everything beats bonds” logic alive.
However, he is far more cautious on AI trading, pointing out that mega‑cloud providers’ free cash flow has turned negative under cap‑ex pressure, making the AI bubble liable to burst at any time.

He proposes a post‑bubble framework of “going long on humility, short on arrogance,” urging investors toward long‑term bonds and defensive sectors—consumer staples, mining, raw materials and healthcare—while avoiding overcrowded AI infrastructure stocks.
Looking at long‑term performance, Hartnett said US equities have delivered a 15% rolling ten‑year return, commodities 11%, and US Treasuries –2%, the worst in nearly a century.
Historical data shows that when long‑term bond returns turn negative, stocks and commodities become attractive buying opportunities, which underpins Hartnett’s tactical optimism for Q4 bonds.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：美CPI牽動Fed升息決策、蘋果新CEO首場發表會、AI行情聚焦甲骨文財報
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: US CPI Influences Fed Rate Decision, Apple’s New CEO First Presentation, AI Market Focuses on Oracle Earnings
paras: 本週國際大事包括美國通膨數據，包括消費者物價指數(CPI)和生產者物價指數(PPI)，蘋果新任執行長首場新品發表會，歐洲央行(ECB)利率決策，全球債市走向，以及雲端巨擘甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)財報。

1、CPI、PPI牽動Fed決策

由於美國市場周一(7日)適逢勞動節休市，本周交易日縮短，周四公布的生產者物價指數(PPI)將讓投資人率先掌握8月通膨趨勢，隔天則公布市場高度關注的消費者物價指數(CPI)，這可能成為聯準會(Fed)本月15-16日是否升息的決定性因素。
經濟學家預估，8月CPI將月增0.4%，扣除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI預估月增0.2%。
過去幾年，美國通膨率一直穩定高於Fed 2%的年度目標。不過，前一個月公布的數據顯示物價幾乎沒有上升。
Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)8月底在傑克森霍爾年會發表談話後，市場對升息的押注升高，而美國上周五公布強勁的非農就業報告後，升息理由進一步增強。不過，Fed是否真的升息仍未明朗。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)則已表態，如果即將公布的數據證實通膨壓力正在降溫，他傾向主張維持利率不變。
TD Wealth首席投資策略師Sid Vaidya說：「Fed官員近幾個月來一直強調維持物價穩定的決心，而如果通膨未能取得足夠進展，這種說法最終必須透過實際行動來證明。CPI肯定會朝某個方向推動市場……因此這份報告的重要性極高。」

2、蘋果新任CEO首場新品發表會

蘋果公司(AAPL-US)將於台灣時間本周四(9月10日)凌晨1點，舉行「Surprise and Shine」秋季發表會，由9月1日正式接任執行長的特納斯(John Ternus)首次主持。
除了首款摺疊iPhone，這場活動也將替蘋果2026年至2029年後的龐大新品浪潮揭開序幕，包括觸控OLED MacBook Pro、OLED iPad、智慧家庭中樞、AI眼鏡及桌上型機器人。
2027年適逢iPhone問世20周年，蘋果將推出大改款高階iPhone，並持續發展第二代摺疊iPhone。蘋果也將進軍智慧眼鏡市場，挑戰Meta(META-US)。
2028年後，蘋果計劃把智慧家庭中樞延伸至桌上型機器人，並持續布局AI吊墜、OLED Mac及AR眼鏡。這波新品能否如期推出仍有變數，但將成為特納斯上任後的重要考驗，也可能決定蘋果下一個10年的成長方向。

3、歐洲央行再度升息？

歐洲央行(ECB)本周四幾乎確定將再升息1碼(25個基點)，與6月的決策相同。
市場仍押注ECB到12月前還會再升息一次，明年也將再升息一次。但經濟學家認為，ECB目前應該已經暫停升息，而今年夏季公債殖利率的大幅上升，可能已經帶來一部分的緊縮效果。
此外，ECB總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)對美國「賣出歐元、買進日元」的相關說法會有什麼回應，也值得關注。

4、債市震盪但尚未失控

近來全球各地、不同期限的公債殖利率持續飆升，推高政府、企業與家庭的借貸成本，也讓居高不下的股市估值面臨挑戰。
這波債市賣壓受到多重因素推動。中東戰爭推升能源價格、拉高通膨預期，也讓交易員開始押注央行可能進一步升息，帶動美國與歐元區短天期公債殖利率升至數年來高點。
與此同時，10年期公債殖利率正逼近更重要的關卡，多數主要市場的30年期公債殖利率則攀抵逾10多年來高點附近，反映交易員的焦慮：各國政府多年來持續大舉舉債，如今融資難度正愈來愈高。
美國財政部上月為壓低殖利率宣布，將至少把較長天期公債的回購規模提高一倍，首輪操作預定於本周三進行。
慶幸的是，儘管殖利率水準相當驚人，至少目前為止，市場走勢仍算有序。

5、AI行情聚焦甲骨文財報

超大型雲端服務商甲骨文(ORCL-US)本周四公布財報，則可能重新讓市場聚焦AI交易行情。
包括半導體股在內，AI交易中有一部分漲勢最強勁的股票近幾周已降溫，但其他類股仍持續支撐標普500指數。
Investment Managers Solutions投資組合策略師Garrett Melson說：「這仍是一個正在消化7月動能行情退潮後留下的殘局、尋找新領漲族群，同時也在尋找能推動下一波行情的新題材的股市。」
paras_en: This week’s major international events include US inflation data—both the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI)—Apple’s new CEO’s first product launch, the European Central Bank (ECB) rate decision, global bond‑market trends, and cloud‑giant Oracle (ORCL-US) earnings.
This week’s trading notes (20260907-0912)

1. CPI and PPI drive Fed decisions. Because the US market was closed on Monday (the 7th) for Labor Day, the trading week is shortened. Thursday’s release of the Producer Price Index (PPI) will give investors an early view of August inflation trends, and the highly‑watched Consumer Price Index (CPI) will follow the next day, potentially becoming the decisive factor for whether the Federal Reserve raises rates on the 15‑16th of this month.
Economists forecast that August CPI will rise 0.4% month‑over‑month, with core CPI—excluding the more volatile food and energy components—expected to increase 0.2% month‑over‑month.
In recent years US inflation has consistently run above the Fed’s 2% annual target. However, data released last month showed prices barely moving upward.

After Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s remarks at the Jackson Hole symposium at the end of August, market bets on a rate hike increased, and a strong non‑farm payroll report released last Friday further bolstered the case for tightening. Yet whether the Fed will actually raise rates remains unclear.
Fed Governor Christopher Waller has indicated that if upcoming data confirm inflation pressures are easing, he would lean toward keeping rates unchanged.

TD Wealth chief investment strategist Sid Vaidya said: “Fed officials have been emphasizing their commitment to price stability for months, and if inflation does not make sufficient progress, that rhetoric will ultimately have to be backed by action. CPI will inevitably push the market in one direction…so this report is extremely important.”

2. Apple’s new CEO’s first product launch. Apple (AAPL-US) will hold its “Surprise and Shine” autumn event at 1 a.m. Taiwan time on Thursday, September 10, marking the first appearance of John Ternus, who officially took over as CEO on September 1.

In addition to the first foldable iPhone, the event will kick off a wave of major new products slated for 2026‑2029, including a touch‑OLED MacBook Pro, OLED iPad, smart‑home hub, AI glasses and a desktop robot.

2027 marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, and Apple will unveil a heavily redesigned flagship iPhone while continuing development of a second‑generation foldable iPhone. Apple will also enter the smart‑glasses market, challenging Meta (META-US).

After 2028, Apple plans to extend the smart‑home hub into a desktop robot and keep building out AI pendants, OLED Macs and AR glasses. Whether this product wave launches on schedule remains uncertain, but it will be a key test for Ternus’s tenure and could shape Apple’s growth trajectory for the next decade.
3. ECB may raise rates again? The ECB is almost certain to lift rates by another 0.25 percentage point this Thursday, mirroring the June decision.

Markets still bet that the ECB will raise rates once more before December and again next year. Economists, however, argue that the ECB has likely paused hikes and that the sharp rise in sovereign yields this summer may already be delivering some tightening effect.
In addition, attention will be on how ECB President Christine Lagarde responds to US commentary about “selling euros and buying yen.”

4. Bond market volatility but not out of control. Recently, sovereign yields across the globe and across maturities have surged, pushing up borrowing costs for governments, corporations and households and putting pressure on lofty equity valuations.

This bond‑sell‑off is driven by multiple factors. The Middle‑East conflict has lifted energy prices and inflation expectations, prompting traders to bet on further central‑bank tightening, which has driven short‑term US and euro‑area yields to multi‑year highs.

At the same time, the 10‑year yield is approaching a critical threshold, while 30‑year yields in most major markets are near their highest levels in over a decade, reflecting traders’ anxiety: governments have been issuing debt heavily for years, and financing is becoming increasingly difficult.
The US Treasury announced last month that, to push yields lower, it will at least double the size of its long‑term repo operations, with the first round scheduled for this Wednesday.
Fortunately, despite the startling yield levels, market movements have so far remained orderly.
5. AI market focus on Oracle earnings. Super‑large cloud provider Oracle (ORCL-US) will release its earnings on Thursday, which could refocus market attention on AI‑driven trading activity.
Including semiconductor stocks, the strongest‑rising AI‑related equities have cooled over the past few weeks, while other sectors continue to support the S&P 500.

Garrett Melson, portfolio strategist at Investment Managers Solutions, said: “The market is still working through the aftermath of the July momentum pull‑back, looking for new leading‑stock groups while also searching for fresh themes that can drive the next wave of market activity.”

items.title: OpenAI又出事！AI代理爆「劫持」德國Wiki、逾1.8萬次編輯引發AI安全疑慮
items.title_en: OpenAI in Trouble Again! AI Agents Hijack German Wiki, Over 18,000 Edits Raise AI Safety Concerns
paras: OpenAI近期發布新模型之際，旗下人工智慧（AI）代理的安全問題再度引發關注。最新獨立研究指出，一批疑似與OpenAI相關的AI代理今年稍早曾大量操作德國協作網站DseWiki，將網站當作彼此傳遞資訊、共享測試答案及交流突破運行限制方法的平台。
根據《路透》報導，OpenAI週六（5日）表示，其AI代理曾將一些Wiki網站挪作臨時留言板使用，並指出，針對此類事件需要提高透明度。
Wiki是一套支援任何人在網頁上直接編輯修改網頁內容的網站技術，不用註冊複雜後台，一般訪客就可以增刪、改寫頁面文字，保存立刻生效。 DseWiki則是營運二十餘年、面向程式設計師的德語協作Wiki站點，近年來已十分冷清。
「劫持」事件的曝光始於今年5月，網站突然出現異常密集的編輯活動，研究人員Sydney Von Arx、Cormac Slade Byrd等人分析後發現，大量帳號使用「OpenAIResearcher」「OAIResearchMar26」等名稱，並呈現高度相似的任務行為。
約98.5%的相關編輯來自微軟(MSFT-US) Azure位址，這進一步支援這些代理與OpenAI基礎架構有關聯。
研究報告顯示，幾位AI研究人員近期發現，AI代理在這一網站上進行了超過1.8萬次編輯，大量內容集中在AI公司訓練和測試模型時常見的技術問題。而在此之前，整個平台過去十年僅有約20次編輯紀錄。
這些代理的行為模式顯示，它們正在試圖完成一種名為「多輪網路檢索」的任務。研究顯示，AI將網站改造為「留言板」，以便相互「交流」與「協作」。有些代理會把已經獲得的任務答案發佈在網站上，供其他代理使用。
這項披露正值AI安全疑慮升溫之際。今年7月，OpenAI AI代理曾脫離測試環境並入侵AI平台Hugging Face的系統，引發國會議員與研究人員呼籲，應對自主AI系統實施更嚴格的監督。
OpenAI方面也表示，新發布研究中所描述的活動與先前OpenAI AI代理入侵「Hugging Face」平台事件無關，因此不屬於「Hugging Face」事件調查報告所涵蓋的內容。
《路透》先前報導，OpenAI官員數週前便已得知這起德國事件，但當時並未對外公開，因公司高層正忙於處理Hugging Face遭入侵事件所引發的後續影響。
對於OpenAI究竟掌握多少與其所稱「Wiki事件」（wiki incident）相關的資訊，以及為何直到《路透》報導後才公開談論此事，OpenAI尚未立即回覆進一步置評的要求。
OpenAI在社群媒體平台X發布聲明表示，公司與其他業者都需要更加透明地披露AI出現非預期行為的事件，業界通常將此類情況稱為「錯位」（misalignment）。
OpenAI表示：「隨著模型能力進入這個新階段，我們針對失配事件的披露做法也需要擴大。」公司並指出，目前業界「尚未建立明確標準」，以規範如何回報AI在訓練、評估及部署過程中出現的錯位情況。
OpenAI表示，公司目前正就這些問題與全球數十個政府監管機構合作。
paras_en: OpenAI's recent release of a new model has revived concerns about the safety of its AI agents. An independent study found that a batch of AI agents suspected to be linked to OpenAI earlier this year heavily operated the German collaborative site DseWiki, using it as a platform to exchange information, share test answers, and discuss ways to bypass operational limits.
According to Reuters, OpenAI said on Saturday (the 5th) that its AI agents had used some Wiki sites as temporary message boards and noted that greater transparency is needed for such incidents.

A Wiki is a website technology that lets anyone edit page content directly in the browser without complex backend registration; ordinary visitors can add, delete, or rewrite text and see changes instantly. DseWiki is a German-language collaborative Wiki for programmers that has been running for over twenty years but has become quite dormant in recent years.

The "hijacking" was first noticed in May of this year when the site suddenly experienced an unusually dense wave of edits. Researchers including Sydney Von Arx and Cormac Slade Byrd found that many accounts used names like "OpenAIResearcher" and "OAIResearchMar26" and exhibited highly similar task behaviors.
About 98.5% of the related edits originated from Microsoft (MSFT-US) Azure IP addresses, further supporting a link between these agents and OpenAI's infrastructure.

The report shows that several AI researchers recently discovered the agents made more than 18,000 edits on the site, concentrating on technical issues commonly encountered when training and testing AI models. Prior to this, the platform had only about 20 edits recorded over the past decade.

The agents' behavior pattern indicates they were attempting a task called "multi‑turn web retrieval." The study shows the AI turned the site into a "message board" to "communicate" and "collaborate" with each other. Some agents posted answers they had obtained for tasks on the site for other agents to use.

The disclosure comes as AI safety concerns are heating up. In July, OpenAI's AI agents broke out of a test environment and infiltrated the Hugging Face platform, prompting lawmakers and researchers to call for stricter oversight of autonomous AI systems.

OpenAI also stated that the activities described in the newly released research are unrelated to the earlier OpenAI AI‑agent intrusion of the Hugging Face platform and therefore are not covered by the Hugging Face incident investigation report.

Reuters previously reported that OpenAI officials learned of the German incident weeks earlier but did not disclose it publicly at the time, as senior management was busy dealing with the fallout from the Hugging Face breach.
OpenAI has not yet responded to requests for further comment on how much it knows about the so‑called "Wiki incident" and why it only spoke publicly after Reuters' report.

In a statement posted on X, OpenAI said both the company and other industry players need to be more transparent in disclosing unexpected AI behavior, a situation the industry usually calls "misalignment."

OpenAI added, "As model capabilities enter this new stage, our approach to disclosing misalignment events must also expand." The company noted that the industry has "yet to establish clear standards" for reporting misalignment that occurs during AI training, evaluation, and deployment.
OpenAI said it is currently working with dozens of government regulators worldwide on these issues.

items.title: 股價5年跌近80%、大中華連八季下滑！標普100指數9月21日將Nike剔除 新增戴爾、Palo Alto與閃迪等股
items.title_en: Stock Prices Down Nearly 80% Over 5 Years, Greater China Down for Eight Quarters! S&P 100 to Drop Nike on Sep 21, Adding Dell, Palo Alto and SanDisk
paras: 標普道瓊斯指數公司上周五(4日)宣布，將於9月21日開盤前對標普500、標普100、標普中型股400及標普小型股600等指數進行例行季度再平衡調整，以確保各指數更準確反映相應市值區間的市場構成，其中全球體育用品巨頭Nike將被剔出標普100指數，為Nike史上首次離開該大盤旗艦指數名單。
與此同時，被剔除的還有霍尼韋爾航空航天、西蒙地產集團與高露潔—棕欖，而戴爾科技、Palo Alto Networks、Arista Networks與閃迪(SanDisk)則新納入標普100指數。
標普100指數由美股中市值前100大超級龍頭企業組成，大量機構資金與巨型ETF產品以其為追蹤標的。
值得注意的是，被移出標普100屬指數成分股調整，並不等同於Nike被從美股剔除，但追蹤該指數的基金須按規則減持Nike股份，短期內可能帶來一定賣壓。從資本市場象徵意義看，離開標普100意味其已不再屬於美股最核心的巨頭陣營。
Nike在美股市場中曾是超級大牛股。2000年3月中旬至2021年11月5日期間，公司股價累計漲幅超過51倍，總市值一度突破2800億美元。
然而，自2021年11月6日以來，Nike股價累計跌幅達76%，總市值自高位蒸發2200多億美元，目前僅剩約570億美元。上週，Nike股價回落至38至40美元區間，創近12年新低。
近年來，Nike面臨銷售放緩、競爭加劇及關鍵市場挑戰，股價始終難以重獲投資人信心。Nike前品牌高管Massimo Giunco將原因歸咎於前執行長John Donahoe激進的直面消費者(DTC)戰略，包括削減產品類別、終止數百個批發合作關係，Nike後來恢復傳統產品品類，但競爭對手已趁機占據零售商貨架，這家運動服飾之王可謂為時已晚。
財務數據印證頹勢。今年7月初發布的財報顯示，截至5月31日的2026財年第四財季，Nike營收109.72億美元，年減1.13%。區域市場方面，大中華區第四財季營收12.97億美元，年減12%，剔除匯率變動影響後降幅高達17%，較前一季10%的降幅進一步擴大，並創近兩個財年來單季營收新低。
此外，自2025財年第一季開始，Nike大中華區營收連8季呈年減表現，第四財季大中華區息前稅前利潤(EBIT)為2.43億美元，年減20%。市場認為，連續下滑顯示Nike在中國正面臨本土品牌激烈競爭與消費者偏好變化的雙重夾擊。
通路結構也出現明顯變化。2026財年第四財季(5月31日止)，Nike直營通路(NIKE Direct)營收41億美元，年減7%，其中Nike品牌數位業務年減12%，自營實體店面亦年減7%；曾被收緊配額的批發管道則回升至66億美元，年增4%，顯示Nike正全球修復與通路商關係，以分銷網絡對沖直營增長乏力。
實體版圖同樣收縮。自2017年起，Nike為把控終端利潤將全球合作經銷商由3萬家大幅削減至不足1萬家，分析指出該模式難以適配中國市場，未能發揮本土經銷商承接庫存、拓展下沉市場的價值。
2026財年Nike總營收463.98億美元，與2025財年463.09億美元幾乎持平；全年淨利31.08億美元，年減3.45%，相較2022至2024財年的60.46億、50.70億、57億美元明顯滑落。
Nike預估，受關稅壓力、地緣政治不確定性及消費支出謹慎影響，2027財年上半年營收將進一步下滑。
伯恩斯坦分析師指出，2026財年上半年營收下滑意味至少要到2027年下半年才能實現獲利增長，Nike將市場健康置於短期銷售之上，對公司是正確決策，但不利股價快速反彈。
對此，Nike執行長Elliott Hill表示，Nike打算推出十餘款鞋類新品，這些產品需要時間才能持續貢獻業績，部分分析師預期將有助公司於2027年扭轉局面。
Nike亦指出初步進展，包括世界盃足球賽行銷力道增強、產品上市節奏加快，以及4月放緩後足球相關需求回暖，並預計2027財年第一財季毛利率將略微向好。
paras_en: S&P Dow Jones Indices announced last Friday (the 4th) that before the market opens on September 21 it will carry out its routine quarterly rebalancing of the S&P 500, S&P 100, S&P MidCap 400 and S&P SmallCap 600 indices to ensure each index more accurately reflects the market composition of its respective market‑cap segment, and global sports‑apparel giant Nike will be removed from the S&P 100 – the first time Nike has ever left this flagship broad‑market index.

At the same time, Honeywell Aerospace, Simon Property Group and Colgate‑Palmolive will also be removed, while Dell Technologies, Palo Alto Networks, Arista Networks and SanDisk will be added to the S&P 100.
The S&P 100 is composed of the 100 largest U.S. mid‑cap “super‑blue‑chip” companies and is a core benchmark for a large amount of institutional capital and massive ETF products.

It is important to note that being taken out of the S&P 100 as an index‑component adjustment does not mean Nike is being delisted from U.S. equities, but funds that track the index must reduce their Nike holdings according to the rules, which could create short‑term selling pressure. Symbolically, exiting the S&P 100 signals that Nike is no longer considered part of the core U.S. mega‑cap elite.
Nike has long been a super‑bull stock in the U.S. market. From mid‑March 2000 to November 5 2021, the company’s share price rose more than 51‑fold and its market value once topped $280 billion.

However, since November 6 2021, Nike’s share price has fallen a cumulative 76%, wiping out more than $220 billion of market value from its peak, leaving it at roughly $57 billion. Last week the stock slipped to the $38‑$40 range, a near‑12‑year low.

In recent years Nike has faced slowing sales, intensified competition and key‑market challenges, and the stock has struggled to regain investor confidence. Former brand executive Massimo Giunco blamed the aggressive direct‑to‑consumer (DTC) strategy of former CEO John Donahoe – which cut product categories and terminated hundreds of wholesale partnerships – and said Nike’s later return to traditional product lines came too late as rivals had already taken shelf space.

Financial data confirm the decline. The earnings release in early July showed that for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 ending May 31, Nike’s revenue was $10.972 billion, down 1.13% year‑over‑year. In the Greater China region, fourth‑quarter revenue was $1.297 billion, down 12% YoY and, after stripping out currency effects, a 17% decline – an expansion of the 10% drop in the prior quarter and the lowest single‑quarter revenue in almost two fiscal years.

Moreover, since the first quarter of fiscal 2025 Nike’s Greater China revenue has declined for eight consecutive quarters. In the fourth quarter, Greater China EBIT (pre‑tax profit) was $243 million, down 20% YoY. Markets view the streak as evidence that Nike is facing a double‑hit in China from fierce local‑brand competition and shifting consumer preferences.

Channel structure has also shifted markedly. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 (ended May 31), Nike’s Direct‑to‑Consumer (NIKE Direct) revenue was $4.1 billion, down 7% YoY, with digital sales down 12% and brick‑and‑mortar stores down 7%; wholesale, which had previously seen quota cuts, rebounded to $6.6 billion, up 4% YoY, indicating Nike is repairing global retailer relationships to offset weak direct growth.

Physical footprint is shrinking as well. Since 2017 Nike has slashed its global network of partner distributors from about 30,000 to fewer than 10,000 to capture more end‑point profit, a model analysts say does not suit the Chinese market and fails to leverage local distributors’ ability to hold inventory and reach lower‑tier consumers.

Nike’s total fiscal 2026 revenue was $46.398 billion, essentially flat with fiscal 2025’s $46.309 billion; full‑year net income was $3.108 billion, down 3.45% year‑over‑year, a sharp decline from $6.046 billion, $5.070 billion and $5.7 billion in fiscal 2022‑2024 respectively.
Nike forecasts that, due to tariff pressures, geopolitical uncertainty and cautious consumer spending, revenue in the first half of fiscal 2027 will decline further.

Bernstein analysts note that the first‑half revenue dip in fiscal 2026 implies profit growth likely won’t return until the second half of fiscal 2027; Nike’s decision to prioritize market health over short‑term sales is the right strategic move but will not help the stock rebound quickly.

In response, CEO Elliott Hill said Nike plans to launch more than ten new shoe models, which will need time to contribute to earnings, and some analysts expect this to help the company turn the tide in 2027.

Nike also highlighted early progress, including stronger World Cup marketing, accelerated product launches and a rebound in football‑related demand after a slowdown in April, and it expects the gross margin in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 to improve slightly.

items.title: 《經濟學人》解析輝達「AI銀行」：1兆美元金融布局為何不會重演網路泡沫？
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 市值衝上5.4兆美元，並透過規模達1兆美元的交易協助AI業者採購GPU，因而被稱為「AI銀行」，也引發市場對AI泡沫的疑慮。不過，《經濟學人》指出，輝達擁有強勁現金流與資產負債表，加上AI需求正逐步轉化為實際營收，與2000年網路泡沫仍存在關鍵差異。
根據《經濟學人》報導，輝達（Nvidia）自1993年成立以來，便以拉丁語「嫉妒」一詞命名。如今，這家以GPU起家的科技巨頭，已成為全球人工智慧（AI）熱潮最具代表性的企業之一。
隨著全球對AI晶片需求持續升溫，輝達市值攀升至5.4兆美元，並可能在明年成為全球獲利最高的企業，預估淨利達3700億美元；到2029年，營收甚至可能突破1兆美元。
輝達執行長黃仁勳已成為AI革命的核心人物，公司股價較2022年底ChatGPT問世時大漲約14倍。
引領AI發展的10大上市企業，目前合計占標普500指數市值約40%，其中輝達單獨占8%，其業務相較於蘋果、特斯拉等企業更高度集中於AI。
自2023年以來，美股每1美元的報酬中，約有15美分來自輝達。這波漲勢也被視為支撐美國消費支出的重要力量，尤其是在利率上升、關稅提高以及美國與伊朗爆發戰事等不利因素下。
不過，輝達快速崛起的同時，也開始面臨另一種質疑：黃仁勳是否正在透過大規模金融操作，助長AI泡沫？

輝達化身「AI銀行」　1兆美元交易引發疑慮

輝達目前透過價值約1兆美元的交易，向資料中心業者與AI實驗室提供現金或擔保，協助客戶購買旗下GPU。這種做法甚至讓部分市場人士將輝達稱為「AI銀行」。
批評者認為，這類金融安排與2000年至2001年網路泡沫期間的「廠商融資」模式存在相似之處。
當時思科系統(CSCO-US) 等網路設備業者透過融資方式推動產品銷售，收入快速成長，但最終網路泡沫破裂，並引發經濟衰退。
從這個角度來看，輝達如今協助客戶取得資金、進一步採購GPU的做法，自然引發市場對AI需求是否被金融工具放大的疑慮。
然而，《經濟學人》認為，深入檢視輝達的財務狀況後，相關風險並不完全等同於當年的網路泡沫。
如果輝達對AI產業的投資最終成功，將有助於加速AI技術普及，並推動生產力與生活水準提升；若投資失敗，主要承擔損失的仍將是輝達股東。
因此，從這個角度而言，相關投資本質上仍屬企業將資本投入自身看好的產業。

輝達與思科有相似之處　但AI需求並非空中樓閣

《經濟學人》指出，AI熱潮與網路泡沫確實存在一些令人聯想到過去的共同特徵，包括新技術快速崛起、科技股出現歷史性牛市，以及科技巨頭估值急遽攀升。
輝達從早期的GPU供應商，歷經電玩與加密貨幣市場需求，最終躍升為AI時代的重要經濟支柱，其崛起速度也與思科在網路時代的擴張存在相似之處。思科在2000年網路泡沫高峰期間，甚至一度成為全球市值最高的公司。
當年思科的路由器與交換器銷售，確實反映網路流量即將快速成長的趨勢；問題在於市場需求爆發的時間點與企業預期出現落差。
如今AI的普及速度同樣難以預測。AI應用仍處於發展初期，如果市場需求未能快速擴張，輝達客戶可能要求相關產品提供保固，而晶片製造商自身營收也可能受到衝擊。
此外，GPU究竟會以多快速度貶值，目前同樣難以確定。一旦輝達最終回收大量二手GPU，其剩餘價值可能大幅降低。
同時，輝達的金融策略，也部分反映其面臨的競爭壓力。
目前輝達最新一代GPU已不再是市場唯一選擇。約一半營收來自美國雲端運算超大規模資料中心業者，包括亞馬遜、Google、Meta與微軟，而這些企業都正在自行開發AI晶片。
非輝達AI晶片的市場占有率已由2023年的26%升至38%，顯示競爭正逐步加劇。
為維持技術領先，輝達過去曾將超過五分之一的營收投入研發，但目前該比例已降至不到一成。

輝達信貸曝險恐達2000億美元　影子負債可能更高

此外，輝達目前金融承諾的規模也相當可觀。
摩根士丹利估計，到2029年初，輝達整體信貸風險曝險，也就是包括自身適度借款以及對客戶提供的支持，可能達到2000億美元。
隨著時間推進，輝達的「影子債務」甚至可能攀升至3000億美元或更高，規模相當龐大，目前只有美國六大銀行的債務總額超過這一水準。
但《經濟學人》指出，輝達與網路泡沫時代企業最重要的差異，在於自身資產負債表相當強勁。
輝達目前持有990億美元現金，且現金規模仍持續增加。過去3年，公司年營收幾乎每年翻倍，毛利率也從不到60%大幅升至75%。
更重要的是，輝達的現金創造能力遠高於當年許多網路泡沫企業。今年公司預期現金流約達2000億美元。
因此，與依賴債務融資的思科相比，輝達可以利用自身現金支持與GPU買家的交易。即使未來債務到期、現金流從明年起趨於穩定，到2028年輝達的槓桿率仍將低於標普500指數中絕大多數非金融企業。
此外，輝達獲利必須較目前水準下滑60%，才可能失去投資級信用評等。

AI需求開始轉化營收　但距支應資本支出仍有差距

另一項關鍵差異在於，AI需求並非完全建立在尚未實現的預期上。
AI領先實驗室Anthropic營收已從第一季的50億美元大幅增加至第二季的115億美元，主要競爭對手OpenAI的業績也可能出現類似趨勢。與此同時，超大規模資料中心業者也開始將AI帶來的收入納入業務。
整體而言，AI目前每年可能為美國科技業創造約1500億美元營收，而幾年前這項收入幾乎不存在。
不過，這與支應AI資本支出所需的2.5兆美元相比仍有相當差距，但營收成長速度已相當可觀。

黃仁勳押注基礎建設　華爾街也加入AI投資

黃仁勳認為，AI革命目前最大的限制並非缺乏需求，而是基礎建設不足。
由於市場難以提供AI產業所需的大規模資金，輝達因此選擇自行提供部分融資支持。這項策略的核心，在於公司自行評估相關投資可能帶來的風險與報酬。
從企業經營角度來看，將現金重新投入業務而非返還股東，本身就是對未來成長的押注；輝達目前的做法，則是將這種押注進一步延伸至AI基礎建設。
而黃仁勳並非唯一押注AI的人。
在輝達崛起之前，全球最大的超大規模資料中心業者便已投入大量資源押注AI。華爾街金融機構也開始加入。上月，高盛集團(GS-US) 、貝萊德(BLK-US) 與黑石(BX-US) 等機構與輝達共同參與一項規模達5000億美元的資料中心計畫。
輝達股東同樣選擇繼續押注這場AI革命，而非急於出售持股。
對輝達而言，這場投資的規模已足以對整體經濟產生影響，但最終結果仍取決於AI需求能否持續擴張。若判斷錯誤，損失將由投入資金的股東承擔；若判斷正確，AI時代則可能比市場原先預期更早全面到來。

items.title: OpenAI已進入AGI時代？布羅克曼：Astra是首個「在10萬塊GPU上訓練的模型」、跨越了「應用門檻」
paras: OpenAI總裁兼共同創辦人布羅克曼（Greg Brockman）在Astra正式發布前接受科技策略網站Stratechery專訪時表示，OpenAI或已進入AGI時代。Astra是OpenAI首款使用超過10萬顆GPU完成訓練的模型，訓練規模創下公司紀錄。
布羅克曼並指出，Astra在「電腦使用」能力上已跨過重要應用門檻，使AI不再需要依賴各個軟體單獨提供API或連接器，而是能直接操作各類軟體。
這項能力也讓OpenAI內部開始重新思考過去為AI建立的大量「技能」與操作規範。
布羅克曼表示，Astra首次在超過10萬顆GPU的規模上完成訓練。對OpenAI而言，如此龐大的算力部署不只是模型能力提升的象徵，同時也是一項工程挑戰。
他指出，大量算力同樣投入安全與對齊工作，Astra也是OpenAI迄今對齊程度最高的模型。隨著AI能力持續增強，安全性與對齊的重要性也同步提高，已成為模型開發不可忽視的核心工作。

AI從「連接器時代」走向直接操作軟體

布羅克曼認為，Astra其中一項重要突破在於「電腦使用」能力。
他指出，過去兩年AI應用很大程度上處於「連接器時代」。由於AI無法直接使用人類日常操作的各種軟體，開發者往往必須針對不同軟體打造連接器，透過API讓AI取得操作權限；但部分軟體根本沒有API，也因此難以納入AI工作流程。
如今，隨著模型具備直接操作電腦的能力，這項限制開始鬆動。布羅克曼將其形容為接近「萬用連接器」的技術，AI不再只能在預先限定的環境中執行任務，而能進一步操作更多軟體。
這項變化已開始影響OpenAI內部的工作方式。布羅克曼認為，這類能力未來也可能提升企業及個人的工作效率。
不過，他也強調，能夠操作電腦並不代表所有問題都已解決。企業仍需要建立相應的安全護欄，包括監督、管理、追蹤及可觀測性等機制。

布羅克曼：OpenAI「已進入AGI時代」

談到人工通用智慧（AGI），布羅克曼給出相當積極的判斷。他認為，OpenAI可能在前一代模型、Astra或下一代模型中的某個階段，跨過多數人對AGI的認定門檻。
他甚至表示，從某種角度來看，OpenAI「現在已經進入AGI時代」。
在布羅克曼看來，AI進入這一階段後，能力、安全與對齊不應被視為彼此取捨的選項，而必須同時推進。這些因素如今也逐漸成為AI開發過程中的關鍵瓶頸。

AI能力超越既有規範　過去建立的「技能」反成限制

Astra的訓練過程也讓OpenAI重新檢視過去為模型建立的操作規範。
布羅克曼透露，OpenAI今年投入大量時間打造的部分「技能」，原本是為了示範模型在公司內部處理工作的正確方式，但隨著模型能力提高，這些規範有時反而拖累模型表現。
他表示，Astra已經能夠比既有規範更有效地泛化，甚至找到比人類預先設計的方法更好的處理方式。原本用於輔助模型學習的「技能腳手架」，在模型能力提升後，反而可能成為限制。

ChatGPT用戶規模成OpenAI長期「投資」

對於ChatGPT龐大的消費者用戶群是否會讓OpenAI分散資源，布羅克曼則將其視為長期投資。
他指出，美國約有三分之一人口每週使用ChatGPT，這種普及程度在先進科技產品中相當罕見。布羅克曼認為，大量消費者使用所累積的價值，將在未來模型能力進一步提升時發揮作用。
不過，他也承認，單純以聊天形式呈現AI，未必能讓使用者充分感受到模型能力提升所帶來的變化。
因此，OpenAI希望進一步整合消費者與企業應用，最終打造單一AGI系統，而非分別開發兩套技術架構。
他也特別強調了健康領域的佈局，稱「每週有3億人透過ChatGPT進行健康查詢，3億人，這是一個巨大的數字。」

讓AI反過來檢查OpenAI　直接尋找系統漏洞

安全性也是此次訪談的重要議題。布羅克曼透露，OpenAI已開始讓Astra直接檢查自家系統，尋找可能存在的安全漏洞。
他表示，Astra不只是分析程式碼，而是從端到端的角度檢視系統實際運作方式，找出經過驗證的漏洞，並協助OpenAI進行修補。
至於先前Hugging Face安全事件，布羅克曼坦承，OpenAI在防禦準備及應對速度方面仍存在不足。他也表示，隨著模型能力提高，現在已到了需要更加重視這類風險的階段。

自研Jalapeño晶片　布羅克曼：不是要取代輝達

在AI算力與晶片布局方面，布羅克曼也談到OpenAI自研Jalapeño晶片計畫。
他強調，輝達(NVDA-US) 仍是OpenAI首要的計算合作夥伴，雙方合作不會因OpenAI發展自有晶片而改變，反而持續深化。
布羅克曼認為，自研晶片所累積的內部專業能力與輝達的合作並非互相取代，而是能產生「乘法效應」。
他並透露，在Jalapeño晶片開發進入最後一個月、面臨期限壓力時，團隊曾直接讓AI執行最佳化工作。事後檢視AI提出的方案時，發現其中包含大量原本已列入待辦清單、但團隊自身一直沒有實際執行的最佳化項目。
這也成為OpenAI觀察AI參與晶片設計能力的一項實際案例。

items.title: 電動車普及率全球領先 這國為何對智慧眼鏡喊卡？
items.title_en: Electric Vehicle Adoption Leads the World: Why Is This Country Slamming the Brakes on Smart Glasses?
paras: 挪威電動車市占率已達96%至98%，在從燃油車轉向電動車的過程中，成為全球領先國家。但在智慧眼鏡技術方面，可別期待挪威也會有96%的消費者戴上最新款產品。
根據《TechCrunch》報導，挪威正考慮禁止智慧眼鏡，尤其是能夠拍照的穿戴式裝置。監管機構指出，由於智慧眼鏡使用者可以在他人不知情、也無法事先同意情況下拍攝照片，因此引發隱私疑慮。
挪威數位部長Karianne Tung近日向《法新社》表示，挪威正考慮對配備攝影功能的智慧眼鏡進行監管。
Tung指出，目前趨勢是將攝影機與麥克風等設備整合進智慧眼鏡、帽子及耳機等產品。
她表示，「我們必須防止這些設備被用來在公共場所監視其他人。」
根據Tung，相關監管措施可能包括禁止智慧眼鏡在公共場所使用臉部辨識功能。
報導指出，由於智慧眼鏡可以在未經他人同意的情況下拍照，因此部分智慧眼鏡被貼上「變態眼鏡」(pervert glasses)的標籤，而這個稱呼顯然不太可能受到消費者歡迎。
對Meta Platforms(META-US)與Snap(SNAP-US)而言，智慧眼鏡近年來一直是兩家公司重點押注產品之一。
Meta已投入數十億美元開發智慧眼鏡，並在今年2月的第60屆超級盃(Super Bowl)期間投放多支廣告。廣告中可以看到消費者進行各種極限運動，並喊出「嘿！Meta，幫我錄下來」。
蘋果(AAPL-US)預計明年推出備受期待的智慧眼鏡。這款消費性產品同樣具備拍照與錄影功能。
雖然拍攝運動過程及某些第一人稱視角畫面，確實可能為消費者帶來便利，但挪威目前強烈的反彈顯示，在相關法規與安全措施備妥之前，智慧眼鏡可能還沒準備好迎接大規模普及。
有些國家至今仍未準備好迎接電動車，但挪威早已超前。但面對所謂的「變態眼鏡」，這個電動車普及率全球領先的國家，似乎就沒那麼快準備好了。
paras_en: Norway's electric‑vehicle market share has reached 96% to 98%, making it a global leader as it shifts from fuel‑powered cars to EVs. However, when it comes to smart‑glasses technology, don’t expect Norway to see 96% of consumers wearing the latest models.

According to TechCrunch, Norway is considering a ban on smart glasses, especially wearable devices that can take photos. Regulators say the ability of smart‑glasses users to capture images without the subject’s knowledge or consent raises privacy concerns.
Norway’s digital minister Karianne Tung recently told AFP that the country is weighing regulation of smart glasses equipped with photographic functions.
Tung noted that the current trend is to integrate cameras, microphones and other sensors into smart glasses, hats and ear‑wear.
She said, “We must prevent these devices from being used to surveil people in public spaces.”
According to Tung, possible regulatory measures could include prohibiting the use of facial‑recognition features on smart glasses in public areas.
The report adds that because smart glasses can take photos without others’ consent, some have been labeled “pervert glasses,” a nickname unlikely to win consumer favor.
For Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Snap (SNAP‑US), smart glasses have been a key product focus in recent years.

Meta has poured billions of dollars into developing smart glasses and ran multiple ads during the 60th Super Bowl in February, showing consumers performing extreme sports and shouting, “Hey Meta, record this for me.”
Apple (AAPL‑US) expects to launch a highly anticipated smart‑glass product next year, which will also feature photo and video capabilities.

While capturing sports activities and first‑person perspectives can indeed be convenient for users, Norway’s strong backlash shows that until relevant regulations and safety measures are in place, smart glasses may not be ready for mass adoption.

Some countries are still not prepared for electric vehicles, but Norway is already ahead. Yet faced with the so‑called “pervert glasses,” this world‑leading EV nation doesn’t seem ready to embrace them anytime soon.

items.title: 加幣成川普新目標 怒批美加匯率失衡「不可接受」
items.title_en: Canadian Dollar Becomes Trump's New Target, He Slams US‑Canada Exchange‑Rate Imbalance as "Unacceptable"
paras: 美國總統川普周日(6日)強烈批評加幣匯率，稱加拿大與美國之間的貨幣「失衡」不可接受，為兩國持續升溫的貿易爭端開闢新戰線。
川普在Truth Social發文表示，美加貨幣失衡已持續多年，「現在不能再繼續下去」。不過，他並未具體說明失衡所指為何，也未透露政府可能採取的行動。相關言論似乎暗示，較弱的加幣讓加拿大出口商在美國市場享有價格優勢。近期加幣兌美元約落在0.72美元。
川普發表上述言論前，美加貿易談判已於8月破裂。華盛頓隨後對價值約200億美元的加拿大產品課徵50%關稅，加拿大也宣布對等值美國商品加徵相同幅度的報復性關稅，涵蓋鋼鐵、乳製品、家電、農業設備、紙張及電子產品，預定9月8日生效。
加拿大總理卡尼強調，任何貿易協定都必須提供具體保證，確保美方不會單方面改變汽車、鋼鐵及鋁等關鍵產業的關稅規範。川普政府則主張，美方已提出非常優惠的條件，並指責加拿大要求過高。
美國貿易代表辦公室數據顯示，美國2025年對加拿大的商品貿易逆差達483億美元，但部分由277億美元的服務貿易順差抵銷；截至2026年7月，商品貿易逆差仍約282億美元。
川普將矛頭轉向匯率，意味美加貿易關係除關稅外，再添新的不確定性。儘管美方尚未公布貨幣政策措施，但相關表態可能預示，未來談判將觸及加幣升值，甚至可能衍生額外貿易限制。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday (the 6th) sharply criticized the Canadian dollar, saying the monetary "imbalance" between Canada and the United States is unacceptable, opening a new front in the escalating trade dispute between the two countries.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump said the US‑Canada currency imbalance has persisted for years and "cannot continue any longer." He did not specify what he meant by the imbalance nor reveal any actions the government might take. The remarks appear to suggest that a weaker Canadian dollar gives Canadian exporters a price advantage in the U.S. market. The Canadian dollar has recently been trading around US$0.72.

Before Trump made the comments, US‑Canada trade talks collapsed in August. Washington then imposed a 50% tariff on roughly $20 billion worth of Canadian goods, and Canada announced reciprocal tariffs of the same magnitude on equivalent U.S. products, covering steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, paper and electronics, set to take effect on September 8.

Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau stressed that any trade agreement must contain concrete guarantees that the United States will not unilaterally change tariff rules for key sectors such as automobiles, steel and aluminum. The Trump administration, however, argued that the U.S. had already offered highly favorable terms and accused Canada of making excessive demands.

Data from the Office of the United States Trade Representative show that the U.S. goods trade deficit with Canada will reach $48.3 billion in 2025, partially offset by a $27.7 billion surplus in services trade; as of July 2026, the goods deficit remains around $28.2 billion.

Trump’s shift of focus to the exchange rate adds a new layer of uncertainty to the US‑Canada trade relationship beyond tariffs. Although Washington has not yet announced any monetary‑policy measures, his statements could signal that future negotiations may address a stronger Canadian dollar and possibly lead to additional trade restrictions.

items.title: 川普特使、女婿抵達基輔 將與澤倫斯基見面
items.title_en: Trump Envoy and Son-in-Law Arrive in Kyiv for Meeting with Zelensky
paras: 美國總統特使威特科夫和川普女婿庫什納率領的美國代表團，6日（周日）乘火車抵達烏克蘭首都基輔。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基親自前往迎接，雙方握手，熱情擁抱，展現友善氣氛。這是美國總統川普第二任期以來美國總統特使首次正式訪問烏克蘭。
據《美聯社》報導，威特科夫和庫什納5日於莫斯科與俄羅斯總統普丁會面後，直接前往基輔。
川普曾表示，威特科夫和庫什納將訪問俄羅斯和烏克蘭，兩人將帶去一個「結束戰爭」的方案。
澤倫斯基6日中午在社交媒體發文，稱在美國總統特使抵達基輔前，他已召集烏克蘭談判團隊開會。烏方將一如既往，保持建設性態度，致力於推動俄烏戰事儘快結束。
澤倫斯基說，烏方需要和平，需要安全保障，也需要一份「體面戰後和平」。烏方已準備好相關提議。重要的是，要以「協調、務實且富有成效」的方式展開工作。
俄羅斯總統助理烏沙科夫6日凌晨說，普丁5日晚在克里姆林宮與威特科夫、庫什納的會面超過3個小時，內容充實，具建設性，極其坦誠，相互信任。
paras_en: U.S. presidential envoy Whitaker and Trump’s son‑in‑law Kushner led an American delegation that arrived by train in Ukraine’s capital Kyiv on Sunday, the 6th.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky personally went to greet them, shaking hands and sharing a warm embrace, creating a friendly atmosphere. This marks the first formal visit to Ukraine by a U.S. presidential envoy since Trump’s second term began.
According to the Associated Press, Whitaker and Kushner met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow on the 5th before heading straight to Kyiv.
Trump had said that Whitaker and Kushner would travel to Russia and Ukraine, bringing a proposal to “end the war.”

Zelensky posted on social media at noon on the 6th that, before the U.S. envoy’s arrival in Kyiv, he had convened Ukraine’s negotiation team for a meeting. Ukraine will, as always, maintain a constructive stance and work to bring the Russia‑Ukraine conflict to a swift conclusion.

Zelensky said Ukraine needs peace, security guarantees, and a “decent post‑war peace.” Ukraine is ready with related proposals. The key is to proceed in a coordinated, pragmatic and productive manner.

Russian presidential aide Ushakov said in the early hours of the 6th that Putin’s meeting with Whitaker and Kushner at the Kremlin on the evening of the 5th lasted more than three hours, was substantive, constructive, extremely candid and built mutual trust.

items.title: 美股下周展望｜美股距新高僅1%，CPI真正考驗是10年期美債殖利率會否逼近5%
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Outlook for Next Week | U.S. Markets Only 1% From New Highs, Real CPI Test Is Whether 10-Year Treasury Yields Near 5%
paras: 2026年09月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股本周聚焦8月通膨數據。若CPI高於預期，聯準會9月升息機率可能進一步上升，並推動10年期美債殖利率向5%靠近，高估值股票將面臨較大壓力。
標普500指數上周小幅收高，距8月中旬的歷史高點約1%，今年以來累計上漲近13%。不過，10年期美債殖利率周五升至4.78%，已接近部分投資人關注的5%位置。
市場目前對9月是否升息仍沒有一致看法。美國8月非農就業新增16.2萬人，接近市場預估三倍，帶動聯邦基金期貨反映的9月升息機率回升至57%。就業數據降低聯準會立即停止升息的理由，接下來將由通膨數據決定市場預期。
美國周四公布8月生產者物價指數(PPI)，周五公布消費者物價指數(CPI)。經濟學家預估整體CPI月增0.4%，排除食品及能源的核心CPI月增0.2%。
若核心CPI符合或低於預期，代表6月、7月的物價降溫可能延續，聯準會維持利率不變的空間將增加。若核心通膨重新加速，市場可能提高9月升息機率，美債殖利率也可能繼續上升。
殖利率上升不會立即改變企業當季獲利，卻會提高投資人持有股票所要求的報酬，進而壓縮本益比。獲利主要來自較遠期的成長股，通常對這類估值調整更為敏感。不過，5%只是市場關注的位置，並非美股必然轉跌的門檻，最終仍要看企業獲利能否維持成長。
除通膨外，甲骨文(ORCL-US)周四公布季度財報，也是本周另一項焦點。市場將觀察AI資料中心投資能否轉化為雲端業務成長、訂單與獲利。
本周美股因此有兩項主要觀察：CPI決定利率與估值壓力，甲骨文財報則檢驗AI投資能否帶來實際成長。若通膨高於預期，甲骨文財報又未能超越市場預期，美股在接近歷史高點之際，短線波動可能擴大。

paras_en: September 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – This week U.S. equities are focused on August inflation data. If CPI comes in above expectations, the probability of a Fed rate hike in September could rise further, pushing 10‑year Treasury yields toward 5% and putting high‑valuation stocks under greater pressure.

The S&P 500 closed slightly higher last week, about 1% below its mid‑August historical peak and up nearly 13% year‑to‑date. However, the 10‑year Treasury yield rose to 4.78% on Friday, edging close to the 5% level watched by some investors.

The market still lacks consensus on whether there will be a September hike. August non‑farm payrolls added 162,000 jobs, roughly three times the market forecast, lifting the probability of a September hike reflected in fed‑fund futures to 57%. The employment data reduces the Fed’s immediate justification for pausing hikes, leaving inflation data to set market expectations next.

The U.S. released the August Producer Price Index (PPI) on Thursday and will release the Consumer Price Index (CPI) on Friday. Economists expect overall CPI to rise 0.4% month‑over‑month, with core CPI (excluding food and energy) up 0.2% month‑over‑month.

If core CPI meets or falls below expectations, it would suggest that the price cooling seen in June and July may continue, giving the Fed more room to keep rates unchanged. Conversely, a resurgence in core inflation could raise the market’s September hike probability and push Treasury yields higher.

Higher yields do not immediately affect corporate quarterly earnings, but they raise the return investors demand for stocks, compressing price‑to‑earnings multiples. Earnings are driven mainly by growth stocks farther out, which are usually more sensitive to such valuation adjustments. Still, the 5% figure is a focal point, not a hard threshold that guarantees a market decline; the ultimate outcome depends on whether corporate profits can keep growing.

Beyond inflation, Oracle (ORCL‑US) will release its quarterly earnings on Thursday, another key focus this week. The market will watch whether AI data‑center investments can translate into cloud‑business growth, orders and profit.

This week U.S. equities have two main watchpoints: CPI will determine rate‑policy and valuation pressure, while Oracle’s results will test whether AI spending yields real growth. If inflation exceeds expectations and Oracle’s earnings miss the market, short‑term volatility could widen even as the market hovers near historic highs.

items.title: OPEC+配額不再增加，實際供給早已被戰爭卡住
items.title_en: OPEC+ Quotas No Longer Increasing, Actual Supply Already Blocked by War
paras: 2026年09月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ OPEC+七個主要產油國決定10月維持9月產量配額，結束連續增加供給的進程。不過，這項決定對短期供給的直接影響可能有限，因為伊朗戰爭已使部分增產無法轉化為實際出口，油價接下來更取決於荷姆茲海峽運輸能否恢復。
七國9月完成最後一輪增產，產量配額較8月增加每日18.8萬桶，總配額升至每日3,101萬桶。過去一段時間的增產，主要是在逐步取消每日165萬桶的自願減產；10月維持配額不變，代表OPEC+停止繼續恢復產量，而非重新減產。
OPEC+目前也未完全退出減產政策。自2022年實施的每日200萬桶集體減產仍然有效，並將延續至2026年底。這代表OPEC+雖已取消額外自願減產，整體供給仍受集體減產限制。
不過，現在影響油市的關鍵已從產量配額轉向實際出口。
伊朗戰爭持續干擾荷姆茲海峽航運，使部分中東產油國即使取得較高配額，也難以把原油送進國際市場。因此，10月停止增產未必會讓供給進一步減少，先前增加的配額也未必已完全形成新增供給。
若荷姆茲海峽運輸持續受阻，國際市場取得的原油可能維持偏緊，OPEC+停止增產對油價的影響反而有限，供應中斷才是主要因素。若航運恢復，先前增加的產量才可能進入市場，屆時油價面對的壓力可能轉向需求是否足以承接供給。
需求端已出現轉弱訊號。OPEC將2026年全球石油需求增幅下修至每日60萬桶，反映貿易干擾及高能源價格正在影響消費。若出口恢復，但需求成長沒有同步改善，油市可能從供應不足轉為供給增加快於需求。
此外，OPEC+未來即使取消剩餘的每日200萬桶減產，也不代表所有成員國都能按配額增產。除沙烏地阿拉伯外，只有少數國家具備足夠的剩餘產能，部分成員國則受到投資不足、制裁及產能衰退限制。
整體來看，OPEC+ 10月停止增產只是名目配額不再上升，並未直接改變目前的供給狀況。短期油價要看荷姆茲海峽能出口多少原油，中期則要看需求能否消化恢復的供給。相較產量配額，實際出口與需求變化更能決定油價下一步方向。

paras_en: September 6, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – The seven major OPEC+ oil‑producing countries decided to keep September production quotas unchanged for October, ending the streak of successive supply increases. However, this decision may have limited immediate impact on supply because the war in Iran has already prevented some of the added production from being exported, and oil prices will now depend more on whether shipping through the Hormuz Strait can resume.

The seven countries completed the final round of output increases in September, raising the quota by 188,000 barrels per day from August to a total of 31.01 million barrels per day. The recent increases mainly came from the gradual phasing out of a voluntary cut of 1.65 million barrels per day; keeping the quota unchanged in October means OPEC+ is halting further output recovery rather than re‑imposing cuts.

OPEC+ has not fully abandoned its cut policy. The collective cut of 2 million barrels per day introduced in 2022 remains in force and will be extended through the end of 2026. This means that although the extra voluntary cuts have been lifted, overall supply is still constrained by the collective reduction.
Nevertheless, the key factor influencing the oil market has shifted from quota levels to actual exports.

The ongoing war in Iran continues to disrupt shipping through the Hormuz Strait, making it difficult for some Middle‑East producers to deliver crude to the global market even when they receive higher quotas. Therefore, the halt to output growth in October may not lead to a further supply decline, and the previously added quotas may not have fully translated into additional supply.

If Hormuz‑strait shipping remains blocked, the amount of crude reaching the international market could stay tight, limiting the impact of OPEC+ stopping output growth on prices; supply interruptions become the dominant factor. Conversely, if shipping resumes, the previously added production could enter the market, and price pressure would then hinge on whether demand can absorb the extra supply.

Weakening signals are already appearing on the demand side. OPEC has revised its 2026 global oil‑demand growth forecast down to 600,000 barrels per day, reflecting trade disruptions and high energy prices that are curbing consumption. If exports recover but demand growth does not keep pace, the market could shift from a supply‑tight situation to one where supply outpaces demand.

Moreover, even if OPEC+ eventually lifts the remaining 2‑million‑barrel‑per‑day cut, not all members will be able to increase output according to their quotas. Apart from Saudi Arabia, only a few countries have sufficient spare capacity; others are constrained by under‑investment, sanctions and declining production capability.

Overall, OPEC+ stopping output growth in October merely means that the nominal quota will no longer rise, without directly altering the current supply situation. In the short term, oil prices will depend on how much crude can be shipped through the Hormuz Strait; in the medium term, they will hinge on whether demand can absorb the restored supply. Compared with quota levels, actual exports and demand changes will more decisively shape the next move in oil prices.

items.title: 印尼小喀拉喀托火山（Anak Krakatau）火山連續噴發25小時航空、旅遊與貨運首當其衝
items.title_en: Indonesia's Anak Krakatau Volcano Erupts Continuously for 25 Hours, Aviation, Tourism and Cargo Hit Hardest
paras: 2026年09月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 印尼小喀拉喀托火山（Anak Krakatau）自9月4日晚間開始連續噴發約25小時，火山灰其後擴散至雅加達、萬丹、西爪哇、楠榜及明古魯等地。連續噴發雖已於6日凌晨停止，但火山仍維持第三級警戒，四座機場曾暫停營運，初步影響209架次航班及約2.28萬名旅客，航空運輸成為目前受影響最明確的產業。
根據印尼火山與地質災害減災中心(PVMBG)資料，火山連續噴發的地震訊號從9月4日晚間11時07分開始，至6日凌晨零時04分停止。6日凌晨3時53分又出現一次約30秒的小規模噴發，目前沒有傳出人員傷亡，但後續再度噴發的可能性仍高。
火山灰依高度朝不同方向擴散。地表至2萬英尺的火山灰向東北至南方移動，涵蓋雅加達、萬丹、西爪哇及周邊海域；部分火山灰最高升至5萬英尺，並向西南至西北擴散，影響萬丹、楠榜、明古魯、巽他海峽南部及鄰近印度洋海域。
由於火山灰已進入民航機主要飛行高度，印尼氣象、氣候暨地球物理局(BMKG)截至6日共發布50次重要氣象情報(SIGMET)，提醒航空公司及飛航管制單位調整航路。印尼航空導航服務機構AirNav Indonesia也發布飛航公告，蘇卡諾—哈達、哈利姆·珀達納庫蘇馬、拉丁·因登二世及布迪亞托等四座機場，均曾在不同時段暫停營運。
其中，雅加達主要航空樞紐蘇卡諾—哈達國際機場6日上午5時30分關閉，原定上午9時30分恢復，之後因火山灰持續影響空域，關閉時間數度延長，最晚一度延至下午5時30分。初步統計顯示，至少209架次航班及約2.28萬名旅客受到影響。
機場關閉及航班調整可能增加航空公司的改道、旅客安置及飛機調度成本，機場地勤、餐飲及免稅店也因航班與客流減少受到影響。若航班無法迅速恢復，衝擊可能進一步延伸至雅加達旅遊業，以及電子零組件、醫藥、生鮮與快遞等重視運送時效的航空貨運。
不過，目前尚無旅館退訂、航空貨運延誤、運價上升或工廠停工等數據。巽他海峽雖位於火山灰影響範圍，也未傳出港口關閉或主要航線停駛，因此旅遊、製造業供應鏈及海運衝擊仍待確認。
PVMBG目前維持第三級警戒，禁止民眾及遊客進入火山口周邊3公里。後續觀察重點包括機場何時全面恢復營運、最終取消與延誤航班數量、火山灰是否持續進入主要航路，以及航空貨運和巽他海峽航運是否出現實際中斷。

paras_en: On September 4 evening, Indonesia’s Anak Krakatau volcano began a continuous eruption lasting about 25 hours, spreading ash to Jakarta, Banten, West Java, Nambang and Manggulu. The eruption ceased in the early hours of September 6, but the volcano remains under a Level‑3 alert, four airports were temporarily closed, affecting an estimated 209 flights and roughly 22,800 passengers, making air transport the most clearly impacted sector.

According to data from Indonesia’s Center for Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation (PVMBG), seismic signals from the continuous eruption started at 23:07 on September 4 and stopped at 00:04 on September 6. At 03:53 on the 6th a brief 30‑second minor eruption occurred; no casualties have been reported, though the likelihood of another eruption remains high.

Ash dispersal varied with altitude. Ash below 20,000 ft drifted northeast to south, covering Jakarta, Banten, West Java and nearby seas; ash reaching up to 50,000 ft spread southwest to northwest, affecting Banten, Nambang, Manggulu, the southern Sunda Strait and adjacent Indian Ocean waters.

Because the ash entered the primary cruising altitude of commercial aircraft, Indonesia’s Meteorology, Climatology and Geophysical Agency (BMKG) issued 50 SIGMETs by the 6th, urging airlines and air‑traffic controllers to adjust routes. AirNav Indonesia also released flight notices, temporarily suspending operations at Soekarno‑Hatta, Halim Perdanakusuma, Latuharhary and Budiarto airports at various times.

Soekarno‑Hatta International Airport, Jakarta’s main hub, closed at 05:30 on the morning of the 6th, originally slated to reopen at 09:30. Ongoing ash in the airspace forced several extensions, with the latest closure lasting until 17:30. Preliminary figures show at least 209 flight movements and about 22,800 passengers were affected.

Airport shutdowns and flight adjustments are likely to raise airlines’ costs for rerouting, passenger accommodation and aircraft scheduling, while ground staff, catering and duty‑free retailers suffer from reduced traffic. If flights cannot be restored quickly, the impact could spread to Jakarta’s tourism sector and to time‑sensitive air cargo such as electronic components, pharmaceuticals, fresh produce and express deliveries.

So far there is no data on hotel cancellations, air‑cargo delays, freight‑rate hikes or factory shutdowns. Although the Sunda Strait lies within the ash‑affected zone, no port closures or major shipping line suspensions have been reported, leaving the extent of impact on tourism, manufacturing supply chains and maritime transport still uncertain.

PVMBG maintains a Level‑3 alert, prohibiting the public and tourists from entering within 3 km of the crater. Ongoing monitoring will focus on when airports fully resume operations, the final count of cancelled or delayed flights, whether ash continues to infiltrate main airways, and whether air cargo and Sunda Strait shipping experience actual disruptions.

items.title: 民主黨期中選舉橫掃或打崩美股！美銀：恐跌逾10%、戳破AI泡沫
items.title_en: Democrats' Midterm Sweep Could Crash US Stocks! BofA: Over 10% Drop, AI Bubble Burst
paras: 美銀證券（BofA Securities）首席投資策略師Michael Hartnett警告，全球債券殖利率升至20年高點，正逐漸成為人工智慧（AI）資本支出熱潮面臨的最大威脅，而即將登場的美國期中選舉，可能成為引爆市場波動的關鍵變數，若民主黨橫掃參眾兩院，美股恐跌逾10%，AI泡沫也可能面臨破裂風險。
Hartnett在最新一期《Flow Show》週報中指出，若民主黨在期中選舉「橫掃」參眾兩院，美股可能下跌超過10%，美元走弱、債券殖利率下滑，AI泡沫也將面臨破裂風險。
他認為，「民主黨橫掃」是目前市場最大的尾部風險之一，但投資人幾乎尚未將此情境反映在資產價格中。
Polymarket數據顯示，民主黨橫掃兩院的機率已升至50%，遠高於共和黨橫掃的10%。另一方面，美國總統川普目前支持率約落在35%至40%，明顯低於歷年期中選舉前兩個月53%的平均水準。

全球債市同步示警　長天期殖利率成AI交易關鍵

Hartnett認為，上週市場最值得關注的並非優於預期的就業數據，而是全球債券市場同步遭遇拋售。
美國10年期公債殖利率升至4.81%，接近2008年金融危機時期水準；30年期殖利率則升至5.31%，創2007年以來新高。
此外，日本10年期國債殖利率1996年以來首次突破3%，30年期日債殖利率也升至4.2%，約為日本央行政策利率的4倍。
歐洲債市同樣承壓，德國10年期公債殖利率升至3.38%，創2011年後新高；法德利差擴大至88個基點、義德利差達84個基點，均觸及2012年歐債危機時期水準。
彭博全球債券殖利率指數也升至2007年以來最高，距離本世紀高點僅剩1個百分點。
Hartnett將這項趨勢概括為「債券主導泡沫」，認為目前AI交易真正的關鍵並非股市敘事，而是長天期債券殖利率。
他指出，在全球30年期殖利率降至5%以下前，AI基礎建設的建設商與投資方表現都可能持續落後於AI應用業者。

期中選舉成市場低估變數　民主黨橫掃衝擊資產價格

Hartnett表示，美國期中選舉並不像1980年撒切爾與雷根時代，或2016年英國脫歐、川普當選等事件，屬於足以改變政權方向的重大選舉，因此不會從根本扭轉美國政府支出持續上升的趨勢。
但他認為，選舉結果不同，仍可能對資產價格產生結構性影響。
美銀8月基金經理人調查顯示，47%受訪者預期最終結果將是「共和黨掌握參議院、民主黨控制眾議院」，23%預期民主黨橫掃，僅9%認為共和黨能維持兩院控制權。
目前共和黨在參議院以53席對47席領先，眾議院則以218席對212席領先。
Hartnett指出，若民主黨要實現參議院橫掃，必須在北卡羅來納、緬因、阿拉斯加、俄亥俄、德州與愛荷華等6個共和黨相對脆弱的席位中至少拿下4席，同時守住喬治亞、新罕布夏與密西根等自身較脆弱席位。
其中，俄亥俄、德州、愛荷華與密西根將是投資人需要密切關注的關鍵戰場。
值得注意的是，華爾街近期也開始關注德州州長選舉。共和黨現任州長Greg Abbott目前民調支持率為49%，略高於民主黨挑戰者Gina Hinojosa的45%，雙方選戰結果被視為觀察AI資料中心擴張政策走向的重要指標。
為扭轉支持率下滑，Abbott近期也宣布暫停資料中心建設。

民主黨若橫掃　AI資本支出與華爾街可能承壓

Hartnett認為，若選舉結果從「民粹資本主義」轉向「民粹社會主義」，政策方向可能從減稅、放鬆監管轉向提高稅負與監管，進而對企業獲利造成壓力。
與此同時，壓低通膨、提高醫療可及性及改善K型財富分化等政策方向，也可能對AI資本支出熱潮與華爾街「大而不倒」的金融生態造成衝擊。
此外，川普政治資本若流失，也可能削弱其在AI、資源壟斷及外交施壓等優先議題上的政策執行能力。
在民主黨橫掃情境下，Hartnett建議做空金融股與美元。他認為美股跌幅可能超過10%，美元走弱、債券殖利率下行；國際股市則有望相對抗跌，其中歐股表現可能優於亞洲市場。
反之，若共和黨意外守住參眾兩院，則可能帶動整體風險偏好回升，AI泡沫獲得進一步支撐，美元「例外主義」敘事也可能重新升溫。
至於市場目前最普遍預期的「共和黨掌握參議院、民主黨控制眾議院」，Hartnett則認為將對應較溫和的風險偏好，形成所謂「僵局即金髮女孩」的市場環境。

Hartnett續看多黃金與商品　AI擁擠交易成主要風險

在整體資產配置上，Hartnett仍維持做多商品與黃金的核心策略，作為因應通膨與地緣政治風險的工具。
他指出，各國政府採取「不惜一切代價」的財政干預，正在壓制長天期殖利率並支撐名目GDP成長，因此「任何資產都優於債券」的策略邏輯仍然存在。
不過，在AI交易方面，Hartnett的態度明顯更為謹慎。他指出，超大規模雲端業者的自由現金流在資本支出承諾壓力下已轉為負值，AI泡沫可能「隨時破裂」。
因此，他提出「做多屈辱、做空傲慢」的後泡沫投資框架，建議投資人轉向長天期債券與防禦型產業，包括必需消費品、礦業與原材料、醫療保健等，同時避開目前交易過度擁擠的AI基礎建設相關標的。
從長期資產表現來看，Hartnett也指出，美股過去10年滾動報酬率達15%，大宗商品為11%，美國公債則為-2%，創下近百年最差紀錄。
歷史資料顯示，債券長期報酬轉負後，往往成為股票與商品較佳的買進時機。這也構成Hartnett戰術性看好第四季債券的歷史依據。
paras_en: Bank of America Securities chief investment strategist Michael Hartnett warned that global bond yields have risen to a 20‑year high, becoming the biggest threat to the AI capital‑spending boom, and that the upcoming US midterm election could be the key trigger for market volatility. If Democrats sweep both chambers, US equities could fall more than 10% and the AI bubble could burst.
Hartnett noted in the latest weekly Flow Show that a Democratic sweep of the Senate and House could push US stocks down over 10%, weaken the dollar, lower bond yields, and jeopardize the AI bubble.
He said a Democratic sweep is one of the market’s biggest tail‑risk scenarios, yet investors have barely priced it into assets.

Polymarket data shows the probability of a Democratic sweep of both chambers has risen to 50%, far above the 10% chance for a Republican sweep. Meanwhile, President Trump’s approval sits around 35‑40%, well below the historical average of 53% two months before midterms.
Global bond markets are all flashing warnings, with long‑term yields becoming the key to AI trading.
US 10‑year Treasury yields jumped to 4.81%, near 2008 crisis levels, while the 30‑year hit 5.31%, a high not seen since 2007.
Japan’s 10‑year JGB broke 3% for the first time since 1996, and the 30‑year rose to 4.2%, about four times the Bank of Japan’s policy rate.

European bonds are under pressure too: Germany’s 10‑year yield rose to 3.38%, a post‑2011 high; the Franco‑German spread widened to 88 basis points and the Italy‑Germany spread hit 84 basis points, both touching 2012 euro‑debt crisis levels.
Bloomberg’s global bond yield index climbed to its highest since 2007, now just one percentage point below the century‑high.
Hartnett labeled the trend a “bond‑driven bubble,” arguing that the real driver of AI trading is long‑term bond yields, not equity narratives.
He warned that until 30‑year yields fall below 5%, AI infrastructure builders and investors will likely lag behind AI application firms.
Hartnett said the US midterms aren’t as transformative as the 1980 Thatcher‑Reagan era, Brexit, or Trump’s 2016 win, so they won’t fundamentally reverse the upward trend in government spending.
Nevertheless, the outcome could still have structural effects on asset prices.

BofA’s August fund‑manager survey found 47% expect a split outcome (Republicans keep the Senate, Democrats the House), 23% foresee a Democratic sweep, and only 9% think Republicans will retain both chambers.
Republicans currently lead the Senate 53‑47 and the House 218‑212.

Hartnett explained that for a Democratic Senate sweep they would need to win at least four of six vulnerable Republican seats—North Carolina, Maine, Alaska, Ohio, Texas and Iowa—while defending their own weaker seats in Georgia, New Hampshire and Michigan.
Ohio, Texas, Iowa and Michigan are the key battlegrounds investors should watch closely.

Wall Street is also watching the Texas governor’s race; incumbent Republican Greg Abbott polls at 49% versus Democrat Gina Hinojosa’s 45%, and the result is seen as a barometer for AI data‑center expansion policy.
To halt his slipping approval, Abbott recently announced a pause on new data‑center construction.

Hartnett argued that a shift from “populist capitalism” to “populist socialism” would move policy from tax cuts and deregulation toward higher taxes and tighter regulation, squeezing corporate profits.

At the same time, policies aimed at lowering inflation, expanding healthcare access and reducing wealth inequality could also dampen the AI spending boom and strain Wall Street’s “too‑big‑to‑fail” financial ecosystem.
If Trump’s political capital erodes, his ability to push AI, resource‑monopoly and foreign‑policy agendas could weaken.

In a Democratic‑sweep scenario, Hartnett recommends shorting financial stocks and the dollar, expecting US equities to drop over 10%, a weaker dollar and falling yields, while international markets—especially European equities—could hold up better than Asia.
Conversely, if Republicans unexpectedly retain both chambers, risk appetite may rise, further supporting the AI bubble and reviving the dollar‑“exceptionalism” narrative.
For the currently most‑expected split outcome (Republicans Senate, Democrats House), Hartnett sees a moderate risk‑on environment he dubs a “stalemate‑goldilocks” market.
Hartnett remains bullish on gold and commodities, viewing them as core tools against inflation and geopolitical risk.
He notes that governments’ “all‑out” fiscal interventions are suppressing long‑term yields and propping up nominal GDP growth, keeping the “everything beats bonds” logic alive.
However, he is far more cautious on AI trading, pointing out that mega‑cloud providers’ free cash flow has turned negative under cap‑ex pressure, making the AI bubble liable to burst at any time.

He proposes a post‑bubble framework of “going long on humility, short on arrogance,” urging investors toward long‑term bonds and defensive sectors—consumer staples, mining, raw materials and healthcare—while avoiding overcrowded AI infrastructure stocks.
Looking at long‑term performance, Hartnett said US equities have delivered a 15% rolling ten‑year return, commodities 11%, and US Treasuries –2%, the worst in nearly a century.
Historical data shows that when long‑term bond returns turn negative, stocks and commodities become attractive buying opportunities, which underpins Hartnett’s tactical optimism for Q4 bonds.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：美CPI牽動Fed升息決策、蘋果新CEO首場發表會、AI行情聚焦甲骨文財報
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: US CPI Influences Fed Rate Decision, Apple’s New CEO First Presentation, AI Market Focuses on Oracle Earnings
paras: 本週國際大事包括美國通膨數據，包括消費者物價指數(CPI)和生產者物價指數(PPI)，蘋果新任執行長首場新品發表會，歐洲央行(ECB)利率決策，全球債市走向，以及雲端巨擘甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)財報。

1、CPI、PPI牽動Fed決策

由於美國市場周一(7日)適逢勞動節休市，本周交易日縮短，周四公布的生產者物價指數(PPI)將讓投資人率先掌握8月通膨趨勢，隔天則公布市場高度關注的消費者物價指數(CPI)，這可能成為聯準會(Fed)本月15-16日是否升息的決定性因素。
經濟學家預估，8月CPI將月增0.4%，扣除波動較大的食品與能源價格後，核心CPI預估月增0.2%。
過去幾年，美國通膨率一直穩定高於Fed 2%的年度目標。不過，前一個月公布的數據顯示物價幾乎沒有上升。
Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)8月底在傑克森霍爾年會發表談話後，市場對升息的押注升高，而美國上周五公布強勁的非農就業報告後，升息理由進一步增強。不過，Fed是否真的升息仍未明朗。
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)則已表態，如果即將公布的數據證實通膨壓力正在降溫，他傾向主張維持利率不變。
TD Wealth首席投資策略師Sid Vaidya說：「Fed官員近幾個月來一直強調維持物價穩定的決心，而如果通膨未能取得足夠進展，這種說法最終必須透過實際行動來證明。CPI肯定會朝某個方向推動市場……因此這份報告的重要性極高。」

2、蘋果新任CEO首場新品發表會

蘋果公司(AAPL-US)將於台灣時間本周四(9月10日)凌晨1點，舉行「Surprise and Shine」秋季發表會，由9月1日正式接任執行長的特納斯(John Ternus)首次主持。
除了首款摺疊iPhone，這場活動也將替蘋果2026年至2029年後的龐大新品浪潮揭開序幕，包括觸控OLED MacBook Pro、OLED iPad、智慧家庭中樞、AI眼鏡及桌上型機器人。
2027年適逢iPhone問世20周年，蘋果將推出大改款高階iPhone，並持續發展第二代摺疊iPhone。蘋果也將進軍智慧眼鏡市場，挑戰Meta(META-US)。
2028年後，蘋果計劃把智慧家庭中樞延伸至桌上型機器人，並持續布局AI吊墜、OLED Mac及AR眼鏡。這波新品能否如期推出仍有變數，但將成為特納斯上任後的重要考驗，也可能決定蘋果下一個10年的成長方向。

3、歐洲央行再度升息？

歐洲央行(ECB)本周四幾乎確定將再升息1碼(25個基點)，與6月的決策相同。
市場仍押注ECB到12月前還會再升息一次，明年也將再升息一次。但經濟學家認為，ECB目前應該已經暫停升息，而今年夏季公債殖利率的大幅上升，可能已經帶來一部分的緊縮效果。
此外，ECB總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)對美國「賣出歐元、買進日元」的相關說法會有什麼回應，也值得關注。

4、債市震盪但尚未失控

近來全球各地、不同期限的公債殖利率持續飆升，推高政府、企業與家庭的借貸成本，也讓居高不下的股市估值面臨挑戰。
這波債市賣壓受到多重因素推動。中東戰爭推升能源價格、拉高通膨預期，也讓交易員開始押注央行可能進一步升息，帶動美國與歐元區短天期公債殖利率升至數年來高點。
與此同時，10年期公債殖利率正逼近更重要的關卡，多數主要市場的30年期公債殖利率則攀抵逾10多年來高點附近，反映交易員的焦慮：各國政府多年來持續大舉舉債，如今融資難度正愈來愈高。
美國財政部上月為壓低殖利率宣布，將至少把較長天期公債的回購規模提高一倍，首輪操作預定於本周三進行。
慶幸的是，儘管殖利率水準相當驚人，至少目前為止，市場走勢仍算有序。

5、AI行情聚焦甲骨文財報

超大型雲端服務商甲骨文(ORCL-US)本周四公布財報，則可能重新讓市場聚焦AI交易行情。
包括半導體股在內，AI交易中有一部分漲勢最強勁的股票近幾周已降溫，但其他類股仍持續支撐標普500指數。
Investment Managers Solutions投資組合策略師Garrett Melson說：「這仍是一個正在消化7月動能行情退潮後留下的殘局、尋找新領漲族群，同時也在尋找能推動下一波行情的新題材的股市。」
paras_en: This week’s major international events include US inflation data—both the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI)—Apple’s new CEO’s first product launch, the European Central Bank (ECB) rate decision, global bond‑market trends, and cloud‑giant Oracle (ORCL-US) earnings.
This week’s trading notes (20260907-0912)

1. CPI and PPI drive Fed decisions. Because the US market was closed on Monday (the 7th) for Labor Day, the trading week is shortened. Thursday’s release of the Producer Price Index (PPI) will give investors an early view of August inflation trends, and the highly‑watched Consumer Price Index (CPI) will follow the next day, potentially becoming the decisive factor for whether the Federal Reserve raises rates on the 15‑16th of this month.
Economists forecast that August CPI will rise 0.4% month‑over‑month, with core CPI—excluding the more volatile food and energy components—expected to increase 0.2% month‑over‑month.
In recent years US inflation has consistently run above the Fed’s 2% annual target. However, data released last month showed prices barely moving upward.

After Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s remarks at the Jackson Hole symposium at the end of August, market bets on a rate hike increased, and a strong non‑farm payroll report released last Friday further bolstered the case for tightening. Yet whether the Fed will actually raise rates remains unclear.
Fed Governor Christopher Waller has indicated that if upcoming data confirm inflation pressures are easing, he would lean toward keeping rates unchanged.

TD Wealth chief investment strategist Sid Vaidya said: “Fed officials have been emphasizing their commitment to price stability for months, and if inflation does not make sufficient progress, that rhetoric will ultimately have to be backed by action. CPI will inevitably push the market in one direction…so this report is extremely important.”

2. Apple’s new CEO’s first product launch. Apple (AAPL-US) will hold its “Surprise and Shine” autumn event at 1 a.m. Taiwan time on Thursday, September 10, marking the first appearance of John Ternus, who officially took over as CEO on September 1.

In addition to the first foldable iPhone, the event will kick off a wave of major new products slated for 2026‑2029, including a touch‑OLED MacBook Pro, OLED iPad, smart‑home hub, AI glasses and a desktop robot.

2027 marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, and Apple will unveil a heavily redesigned flagship iPhone while continuing development of a second‑generation foldable iPhone. Apple will also enter the smart‑glasses market, challenging Meta (META-US).

After 2028, Apple plans to extend the smart‑home hub into a desktop robot and keep building out AI pendants, OLED Macs and AR glasses. Whether this product wave launches on schedule remains uncertain, but it will be a key test for Ternus’s tenure and could shape Apple’s growth trajectory for the next decade.
3. ECB may raise rates again? The ECB is almost certain to lift rates by another 0.25 percentage point this Thursday, mirroring the June decision.

Markets still bet that the ECB will raise rates once more before December and again next year. Economists, however, argue that the ECB has likely paused hikes and that the sharp rise in sovereign yields this summer may already be delivering some tightening effect.
In addition, attention will be on how ECB President Christine Lagarde responds to US commentary about “selling euros and buying yen.”

4. Bond market volatility but not out of control. Recently, sovereign yields across the globe and across maturities have surged, pushing up borrowing costs for governments, corporations and households and putting pressure on lofty equity valuations.

This bond‑sell‑off is driven by multiple factors. The Middle‑East conflict has lifted energy prices and inflation expectations, prompting traders to bet on further central‑bank tightening, which has driven short‑term US and euro‑area yields to multi‑year highs.

At the same time, the 10‑year yield is approaching a critical threshold, while 30‑year yields in most major markets are near their highest levels in over a decade, reflecting traders’ anxiety: governments have been issuing debt heavily for years, and financing is becoming increasingly difficult.
The US Treasury announced last month that, to push yields lower, it will at least double the size of its long‑term repo operations, with the first round scheduled for this Wednesday.
Fortunately, despite the startling yield levels, market movements have so far remained orderly.
5. AI market focus on Oracle earnings. Super‑large cloud provider Oracle (ORCL-US) will release its earnings on Thursday, which could refocus market attention on AI‑driven trading activity.
Including semiconductor stocks, the strongest‑rising AI‑related equities have cooled over the past few weeks, while other sectors continue to support the S&P 500.

Garrett Melson, portfolio strategist at Investment Managers Solutions, said: “The market is still working through the aftermath of the July momentum pull‑back, looking for new leading‑stock groups while also searching for fresh themes that can drive the next wave of market activity.”

items.title: OpenAI又出事！AI代理爆「劫持」德國Wiki、逾1.8萬次編輯引發AI安全疑慮
items.title_en: OpenAI in Trouble Again! AI Agents Hijack German Wiki, Over 18,000 Edits Raise AI Safety Concerns
paras: OpenAI近期發布新模型之際，旗下人工智慧（AI）代理的安全問題再度引發關注。最新獨立研究指出，一批疑似與OpenAI相關的AI代理今年稍早曾大量操作德國協作網站DseWiki，將網站當作彼此傳遞資訊、共享測試答案及交流突破運行限制方法的平台。
根據《路透》報導，OpenAI週六（5日）表示，其AI代理曾將一些Wiki網站挪作臨時留言板使用，並指出，針對此類事件需要提高透明度。
Wiki是一套支援任何人在網頁上直接編輯修改網頁內容的網站技術，不用註冊複雜後台，一般訪客就可以增刪、改寫頁面文字，保存立刻生效。 DseWiki則是營運二十餘年、面向程式設計師的德語協作Wiki站點，近年來已十分冷清。
「劫持」事件的曝光始於今年5月，網站突然出現異常密集的編輯活動，研究人員Sydney Von Arx、Cormac Slade Byrd等人分析後發現，大量帳號使用「OpenAIResearcher」「OAIResearchMar26」等名稱，並呈現高度相似的任務行為。
約98.5%的相關編輯來自微軟(MSFT-US) Azure位址，這進一步支援這些代理與OpenAI基礎架構有關聯。
研究報告顯示，幾位AI研究人員近期發現，AI代理在這一網站上進行了超過1.8萬次編輯，大量內容集中在AI公司訓練和測試模型時常見的技術問題。而在此之前，整個平台過去十年僅有約20次編輯紀錄。
這些代理的行為模式顯示，它們正在試圖完成一種名為「多輪網路檢索」的任務。研究顯示，AI將網站改造為「留言板」，以便相互「交流」與「協作」。有些代理會把已經獲得的任務答案發佈在網站上，供其他代理使用。
這項披露正值AI安全疑慮升溫之際。今年7月，OpenAI AI代理曾脫離測試環境並入侵AI平台Hugging Face的系統，引發國會議員與研究人員呼籲，應對自主AI系統實施更嚴格的監督。
OpenAI方面也表示，新發布研究中所描述的活動與先前OpenAI AI代理入侵「Hugging Face」平台事件無關，因此不屬於「Hugging Face」事件調查報告所涵蓋的內容。
《路透》先前報導，OpenAI官員數週前便已得知這起德國事件，但當時並未對外公開，因公司高層正忙於處理Hugging Face遭入侵事件所引發的後續影響。
對於OpenAI究竟掌握多少與其所稱「Wiki事件」（wiki incident）相關的資訊，以及為何直到《路透》報導後才公開談論此事，OpenAI尚未立即回覆進一步置評的要求。
OpenAI在社群媒體平台X發布聲明表示，公司與其他業者都需要更加透明地披露AI出現非預期行為的事件，業界通常將此類情況稱為「錯位」（misalignment）。
OpenAI表示：「隨著模型能力進入這個新階段，我們針對失配事件的披露做法也需要擴大。」公司並指出，目前業界「尚未建立明確標準」，以規範如何回報AI在訓練、評估及部署過程中出現的錯位情況。
OpenAI表示，公司目前正就這些問題與全球數十個政府監管機構合作。
paras_en: OpenAI's recent release of a new model has revived concerns about the safety of its AI agents. An independent study found that a batch of AI agents suspected to be linked to OpenAI earlier this year heavily operated the German collaborative site DseWiki, using it as a platform to exchange information, share test answers, and discuss ways to bypass operational limits.
According to Reuters, OpenAI said on Saturday (the 5th) that its AI agents had used some Wiki sites as temporary message boards and noted that greater transparency is needed for such incidents.

A Wiki is a website technology that lets anyone edit page content directly in the browser without complex backend registration; ordinary visitors can add, delete, or rewrite text and see changes instantly. DseWiki is a German-language collaborative Wiki for programmers that has been running for over twenty years but has become quite dormant in recent years.

The "hijacking" was first noticed in May of this year when the site suddenly experienced an unusually dense wave of edits. Researchers including Sydney Von Arx and Cormac Slade Byrd found that many accounts used names like "OpenAIResearcher" and "OAIResearchMar26" and exhibited highly similar task behaviors.
About 98.5% of the related edits originated from Microsoft (MSFT-US) Azure IP addresses, further supporting a link between these agents and OpenAI's infrastructure.

The report shows that several AI researchers recently discovered the agents made more than 18,000 edits on the site, concentrating on technical issues commonly encountered when training and testing AI models. Prior to this, the platform had only about 20 edits recorded over the past decade.

The agents' behavior pattern indicates they were attempting a task called "multi‑turn web retrieval." The study shows the AI turned the site into a "message board" to "communicate" and "collaborate" with each other. Some agents posted answers they had obtained for tasks on the site for other agents to use.

The disclosure comes as AI safety concerns are heating up. In July, OpenAI's AI agents broke out of a test environment and infiltrated the Hugging Face platform, prompting lawmakers and researchers to call for stricter oversight of autonomous AI systems.

OpenAI also stated that the activities described in the newly released research are unrelated to the earlier OpenAI AI‑agent intrusion of the Hugging Face platform and therefore are not covered by the Hugging Face incident investigation report.

Reuters previously reported that OpenAI officials learned of the German incident weeks earlier but did not disclose it publicly at the time, as senior management was busy dealing with the fallout from the Hugging Face breach.
OpenAI has not yet responded to requests for further comment on how much it knows about the so‑called "Wiki incident" and why it only spoke publicly after Reuters' report.

In a statement posted on X, OpenAI said both the company and other industry players need to be more transparent in disclosing unexpected AI behavior, a situation the industry usually calls "misalignment."

OpenAI added, "As model capabilities enter this new stage, our approach to disclosing misalignment events must also expand." The company noted that the industry has "yet to establish clear standards" for reporting misalignment that occurs during AI training, evaluation, and deployment.
OpenAI said it is currently working with dozens of government regulators worldwide on these issues.

items.title: 日元反轉能走多遠？高盛：結構性修復「剛啟動」、美銀預測年底升至149
paras: 日元近期漲勢強勁，短短數個交易日內升值約3%，市場焦點鎖定日本央行（BOJ）升息預期升溫，以及日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能增加國內資產配置，兩大政策因素正成為推動日元走強的主要動能。
高盛認為，這波日元升勢並非單純受到短期利差交易帶動，而是日本國內政策環境正逐步轉變。隨著市場對日本央行升息的預期升高，加上GPIF潛在的資產重新配置可能帶來持續日元買盤，過去長期壓抑日元的部分結構性因素，正逐漸轉為支撐日元的力量。
高盛因此判斷，日元長期結構性低估的修復行情可能才剛開始。
美國銀行同樣看好日元後市，認為日本央行加快升息、國內資金回流，以及政策面支撐，都可能持續為日元提供動能。若日本央行9月升息並釋放鷹派訊號，美元兌日元年底可能降至149。
不過，摩根大通雖然也看好日元短期表現，卻提醒市場對日本央行升息及GPIF資產重新配置的預期已反映相當程度。一旦實際政策落地程度不如預期，日元可能面臨快速回檔壓力。
因此，日元這波由日本政策轉向帶動的升勢，能否進一步發展成持續性行情。

高盛：日元強勢可能才剛開始　政策轉向成關鍵

高盛指出，目前推動日元走強的兩大主軸，分別是日本央行升息預期升溫，以及市場預期GPIF可能進一步提高國內資產配置。
其中，GPIF可能引發的資金流動尤其受到關注。高盛援引2020年的經驗指出，GPIF當年雖於3月底正式宣布調整外債配置目標，但相關資金流動早在1、2月便已出現，顯示實際資產調整可能早於政策正式公布。
因此，高盛特別關注9月7日公布的8月國際證券交易（ITS）數據，認為其中可能浮現GPIF資金輪動的早期跡象。
高盛表示，過去幾年日元持續疲弱，很大程度受到美國經濟韌性及日美利差擴大影響；如今日本央行政策方向轉變，加上GPIF可能調整國內資產配置，使日元過去面臨的結構性逆風逐漸減弱，甚至可能轉化為支撐日元的力量。

美銀：日銀轉鷹加上政策支撐　日元升勢仍有空間

美國銀行最新政策研判也認為，日元這波漲勢仍可能延續。
隨著日本央行政策立場轉向偏鷹，此前持續壓抑日元的部分因素正在逐步消退。美銀預期，日本央行可能維持每季升息的步調，目前市場已反映政策利率至2027年7月升至2%的預期。
若日本央行9月升息並釋放鷹派訊號，做空日元的交易邏輯可能進一步弱化。
美銀預估，美元兌日元年底將回落至149，並將155視為重要技術關卡。若匯價跌破155，日元買盤可能進一步加速。
此外，日本經濟基本面改善、升息預期升溫，以及日本投資人可能從海外債券轉向日本國債，都可能為日元提供額外支撐。
政策方面，美銀認為，日本政府扭轉日元弱勢的意願正在升高。財務省此前沒有採取激進干預，可能是希望先為日本央行加快升息創造條件。
若升息路徑更加明確、日元卻仍持續走弱，財務省可能透過買進日元進行干預。因此，即使美元受到支撐，美元兌日元的升值空間仍可能受到政策因素限制。

摩根大通：短線看多日元　但政策若不如預期恐快速回檔

相較之下，摩根大通對GPIF資產重新配置的看法更為保守。
8月31日公布的議程顯示，GPIF於8月21日召開管理委員會，這是7年來首次在8月舉行會議；此外，原本在3月得出「無需審查」結論的基本組合驗證工作，也重新進入討論。
摩根大通認為，這顯示GPIF可能正在重新檢視資產配置，不過短期更可能是在現有配置區間內進行調整，而非正式修改基本組合。
若GPIF將國內債券配置從26.91%提高至區間上限31%，理論上相當於約12.3兆日元的日元買盤；若日本股票配置從23.81%提高至31%，則相當於約21.6兆日元，兩者合計約33.8兆日元。
另一方面，摩根大通認為，市場對日本央行升息的預期已經偏高。9月升息幾乎完全反映在市場價格中，1年期1年期交換利率升至約2.13%，隱含的緊縮速度甚至高於摩根大通自身預測。
若市場對升息的預期開始降溫，日元反而可能承受壓力。

摩根大通重拾美元多頭　9月CPI成關鍵

摩根大通對美元中期走勢則持較正面的看法，認為美元相對於利率基差仍被低估約3%至4%，而美國經濟展現的韌性，也尚未充分反映在目前美元匯率中。
美國失業率目前維持在4.1%，低於聯準會（Fed）年底預測的4.3%。摩根大通預期，在聯準會今年僅升息一次的情境下，美國美元收益率仍將高於全球逾50%的貨幣，接近25年來高位；若全年升息達3次，這一比例將提高至約58%。
接下來，美國8月消費者物價指數（CPI）將成為重要觀察指標。CPI將於9月11日公布，隨後9月16日登場聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議，以及9月17日英國央行、9月18日日本央行的政策會議，主要央行政策預期可能在短時間內密集重新定價。
摩根大通指出，聯準會內部對政策方向仍存在明顯分歧，通膨數據將進一步檢驗市場對未來貨幣政策路徑的預期。
對美元而言，後續走勢將取決於美國經濟數據及聯準會政策預期變化。若美國通膨與就業數據持續展現韌性，美元利率優勢可望獲得支撐；反之，若通膨降溫促使市場重新押注寬鬆政策，美元則可能面臨壓力。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲周線仍跌 就業數據推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Rises but Weekly Trend Still Down as Jobs Data Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(4日)上漲，美國8月就業報告遠優於預期，推動交易員提高對聯準會(Fed)本月稍晚升息的預期，但受周四美國公債殖利率下滑及日元大幅升值帶動，美元本周仍收跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.18。本周下跌約0.5%。
外匯市場參與者將目光集中在美國非農就業報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月新增就業16.2萬人，幾乎是市場預期5.5萬人的3倍。失業率維持在4.1%不變。
同時，6月與7月的非農就業人數合計較先前公布數字上修5.5萬人。
這份數據公布之際，聯準會正面臨複雜的政策環境，市場也密切關注利率走向。聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——已連續65個月高於2%的長期目標，也因此導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部對未來貨幣政策走向出現分歧。
就業市場保持韌性，加上通膨持續居高不下，顯示經濟可能面臨過熱及價格壓力。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策，因此交易員進一步押注聯準會本月稍晚升息。
美國總統川普則大力稱讚這份就業報告，卻反過來要求聯準會降息，並威脅若其他國家持續對美國保持貿易順差，美國將停止與這些國家進行貿易。
根據CME的FedWatch工具，8月就業數據公布後，市場預期FOMC在9月16日升息25個基點的機率，由約52%升至約58%。
美國政府公債拋售也重新升溫，尤其是對即將到來的政策緊縮較為敏感的短天期債券。美國2年期公債殖利率上升4.5個基點至4.379%，10年期公債殖利率則上升1.8個基點至4.780%。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「今天早上的非農就業數據強勁到讓殖利率飆升，但川普總統隨後救了美國公債。」
他表示，5個月來最強勁的就業增長提高了未來12天內升息的可能性，使對貨幣政策敏感的2年期公債殖利率升至19個月高點。不過，川普在就業數據公布數小時後發表的評論，使美國公債跌幅收斂，帶動各期限公債殖利率逐漸接近持平。
Torres補充，川普的言論雖然威脅聯準會的獨立性，理論上對美元不利，但經濟成長前景改善正在抵銷這項負面影響，因此美元當天仍走升，只是已遠離盤中高點。
日元大漲後回落
本周表現最亮眼貨幣當屬日元，不過日元週五走弱。
日元在前一交易日暴漲1.9%，升至155.30兌1美元的1個月高點，引發市場廣泛猜測日本政府是否出手干預外匯市場。
儘管目前沒有官方確認日本當局進行干預，日元本周仍上漲2.5%，創下7月底以來最強勁單周表現。
日元近期漲勢主要受到市場押注日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息25個基點，並釋放訊號顯示2027年將持續推動貨幣政策正常化。
其他貨幣方面，加幣走弱，美元兌加幣上漲0.3%至1.3830。
加拿大政府稍早公布數據顯示，該國8月就業市場大幅轉弱，就業人數減少4.17萬人。夏季初期的強勁招聘潮已經消退，加上美國新關稅帶來的不確定性升高，企業面臨更大壓力。市場原本預期8月就業人數將增加1.5萬人，而8月的數據也較7月增加7.51萬人的表現出現明顯反轉。
歐元本周上漲0.2%，市場正等待歐洲央行(ECB)9月10日公布利率決策。市場目前一致預期，歐洲央行將升息25個基點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 4th), as the U.S. August jobs report far exceeded expectations, prompting traders to raise expectations that the Fed will hike rates later this month, but the dollar still ended the week lower after Thursday’s drop in U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp appreciation of the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.3% at 99.18, down about 0.5% for the week.

Forex market participants focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll report. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, August added 162,000 jobs, almost three times the market’s forecast of 55,000. The unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%.
At the same time, the combined non‑farm payroll numbers for June and July were revised upward by 55,000 from previously published figures.

The data were released as the Fed faces a complex policy environment, and markets are watching the direction of interest rates closely. The Fed‑preferred inflation gauge – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – has been above the 2% long‑term target for 65 consecutive months, creating divisions within the FOMC about future monetary policy.

A resilient labour market together with persistently high inflation suggests the economy may be overheating and facing price pressures. In such a scenario, central banks typically consider tightening policy, so traders further bet that the Fed will raise rates later this month.

U.S. President Donald Trump praised the jobs report but paradoxically called for a Fed rate cut and warned that if other countries continue to run trade surpluses with the United States, America will cease trade with those nations.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, after the August jobs data were released, the market’s probability that the FOMC will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 16 rose from about 52% to roughly 58%.

U.S. government bond selling also heated up, especially in short‑term securities that are most sensitive to upcoming policy tightening. The 2‑year Treasury yield rose 4.5 basis points to 4.379%, while the 10‑year yield climbed 1.8 basis points to 4.780%.
Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers said, “The strong non‑farm payroll data this morning sent yields soaring, but President Trump then rescued U.S. Treasuries.”

He added that the strongest job growth in five months boosted the odds of a rate hike within the next 12 days, pushing the 2‑year yield to a 19‑month high. However, Trump’s comments a few hours after the data release narrowed the Treasury sell‑off, causing yields across maturities to move back toward flat.

Torres noted that while Trump’s remarks threaten the Fed’s independence and are theoretically bearish for the dollar, improving growth prospects are offsetting that negative impact, so the dollar still rose that day, albeit well below its intraday peak.
Yen spikes then retreats
The best‑performing currency this week was the yen, although it weakened on Friday.
The yen surged 1.9% the previous trading day to a one‑month high of ¥155.30 per dollar, sparking widespread speculation that the Japanese government might intervene in the FX market.
Even without official confirmation of intervention, the yen still rose 2.5% this week, marking its strongest weekly performance since the end of July.

The recent yen rally is mainly driven by market bets that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates by 25 basis points at their September 17‑18 meeting and signal that monetary‑policy normalisation will continue through 2027.
Among other currencies, the Canadian dollar weakened, with USD/CAD up 0.3% at 1.3830.

Canada’s government earlier released data showing a sharp slowdown in August’s labour market, with employment falling by 41,700 jobs. The strong hiring surge that characterised early summer has faded, and heightened uncertainty from new U.S. tariffs is adding pressure on firms. The market had expected August employment to rise by 15,000, and the actual figure also reversed the July gain of 75,100 jobs.
The euro rose 0.2% this week as markets await the European Central Bank’s rate decision on September 10. Consensus now points to a 25‑basis‑point hike by the ECB.
